title: 期货公司董事、监事和高级管理人员任职管理办法
content: 为了加强对期货公司董事、监事和高级管理人员的任职管理,规 范期货公司运作,防 范经营风险,根 据《中华人民共和国公司法》( 以下简称《 公司法》)、《中华人民共和国期货和衍生品法》 和《 期货交易管理条例》, 制定本办法。 期货公司董事、 监事和高级管理人员的任职管理,适用本办法。 本办法所称高级管理人员,是 指期货公司的总经理、副总经理、首 席风险官( 以下简称经理层人员),财务负责人以及实际履行上述职务的人员。 期货公司分支机构负责人的管理参照本办法有关高级管理人员的相关规定执行。 期货公司董事、监事和高级管理人员应当符合中国证券监督管理委员会( 以下简称中国证监会) 规定的任职条件。 期货公司不得任用不符合任职条件的人员担任董事、监事和高级管理人员。

As a result, the vessel’s 22 crew members had to be evacuated for safety reasons, with the exception of the captain and his deputy. The CPC called on the countries that are members of the consortium to condemn the aggression and take measures to stop the Ukrainian terrorist attacks against infrastructure used to export hydrocarbons extracted in Kazakhstan. title: Bessent说，美国可能会因AI模型“盗窃”而制裁中国
content:
美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）周二表示，特朗普政府将调查中国人工智能模型是否从美国模型中提取，并表示政府不支持“知识产权盗窃”。

中国的开放式体重模型正在与OpenAI和Anthropic等美国公司的领先产品竞争，引发了科技高管和政府官员对美国在人工智能竞赛中领先地位的持久性的担忧。中国初创公司Moonshot AI，本月早些时候发布了一个名为Kimi K3的模型，该模型在一些行业基准上的表现优于这些公司。开放权重指的是模型的最终训练参数公开发布供下载，而底层代码和训练数据保持私有。

“如果我们看到，特别是海外模特从我们伟大的公司偷窃，我们有能力制裁他们，因为这种盗窃，”贝森特告诉福克斯商业的“与玛丽亚的早晨”周二。

Bessent说，这种盗窃的技术术语称为蒸馏，这是一种人工智能训练方法，使用现有的更强大的模型的输出构建一个更小，功能更弱的模型。Anthropic上个月向美国参议院银行，住房和城市事务委员会发出一封信，声称中国科技公司阿里巴巴对其进行了迄今为止“最大的已知蒸馏攻击”。

据路透社周二报道，美国和中国计划在9月围绕人工智能举行会谈。报道称，贝森特将代表美国参加讨论。

贝森特周二表示：“我们在许多中国模型上发现了美国大型语言模型的水印，这是不可接受的。我们将在未来几天或几周内对此进行研究。”

但近年来，Anthropic和OpenAI都面临着自己的盗窃指控。

excerpt: Bessent says U.S. could sanction China over AI model 'theft'
fullText:
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Tuesday said the Trump administration will look into whether Chinese artificial intelligence models have been distilled from American models, stating that the government does not support "IP theft."

Chinese open-weight models are gaining steam against leading offerings from American companies like OpenAI and Anthropic , sparking concerns from tech executives and government officials about the durability of the U.S. lead in the AI race. Moonshot AI, a Chinese startup, released a model called Kimi K3 earlier this month that outperforms those companies across some industry benchmarks. Open weight refers to models whose final trained parameters are publicly released for download, while the underlying code and training data remain private.

"If we see, especially that overseas models are stealing from our great companies, we have the ability to sanction them because of this theft," Bessent told Fox Business' "Mornings with Maria" on Tuesday.

Bessent said the technical term for this theft is called distillation, which is an AI training method where a smaller, less capable model is built using outputs from an existing, stronger model. Anthropic sent a letter to the U.S. Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs last month alleging that the Chinese tech company Alibaba had carried out the "the largest known distillation attack" against it to date.

The U.S. and China are planning to hold talks around AI in September, according to a report from Reuters on Tuesday. Bessent will represent the U.S. during the discussions, the report said.

"We are finding watermarks of our U.S. large language models on many of the Chinese models, and that's unacceptable," Bessent said Tuesday. "We're going to be looking at that in the coming days or weeks."

But both Anthropic and OpenAI have faced their own accusations of theft in recent years.

Anthropic agreed to pay $1.5 billion in September to settle a class action lawsuit with a group of authors, who alleged that the company illegally downloaded books from pirated databases. The New York Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft in 2023, alleging that the companies infringed on copyright by using its intellectual property to train models.

“如果我们看到，特别是海外模特从我们伟大的公司偷窃，我们有能力制裁他们，因为这种盗窃，”贝森特告诉福克斯商业的“与玛丽亚的早晨”周二。

Bessent说，这种盗窃的技术术语称为蒸馏，这是一种人工智能训练方法，使用现有的更强大的模型的输出构建一个更小，功能更弱的模型。Anthropic上个月向美国参议院银行，住房和城市事务委员会发出一封信，声称中国科技公司阿里巴巴对其进行了迄今为止“最大的已知蒸馏攻击”。

据路透社周二报道，美国和中国计划在9月围绕人工智能举行会谈。报道称，贝森特将代表美国参加讨论。

贝森特周二表示：“我们在许多中国模型上发现了美国大型语言模型的水印，这是不可接受的。我们将在未来几天或几周内对此进行研究。”

但近年来，Anthropic和OpenAI都面临着自己的盗窃指控。

title: 中国对14家欧洲科技公司实施对等制裁
content: 在欧盟将中国公司纳入对俄罗斯的第21轮制裁后，中国于本周二对14家欧盟国防和技术公司实施了立即出口管制。-报复措施针对关键的工业和战略部门。在受影响的实体中，北京将意大利电动机制造商Lafert、法国无人机制造商Cavok UAS、德国主要的国防制造商莱茵金属公司（Rheinmetall）。限制名单还包括荷兰造船厂IHC Merwede（以皇家IHC品牌运营）和德国涂料专业公司Sindlhauser Materials。根据这些新规定，中国供应商和运营商被严格禁止向这些欧洲公司提供军民两用产品。欧盟就第21轮对俄制裁达成协议这些物项涉及民用和军用技术和材料。此外，中国禁止任何外国组织或个人向黑名单企业转让或便利中国原产的两用物项。中国商务部认为，监管行动是保护中国经济的必要步骤。

title_en: China Imposes Reciprocal Sanctions on 14 European Technology Companies

content_en: China imposed immediate export controls on 14 European Union defense and technology firms this Tuesday, after the European Union included Chinese companies in its 21st package of sanctions against Russia. --- The retaliatory measures target critical industrial and strategic sectors. Among the affected entities, Beijing blacklisted the Italian electric motor manufacturer Lafert, the French drone producer Cavok UAS, and the major German defense manufacturer Rheinmetall. The restriction list also includes the Dutch shipbuilder IHC Merwede, operating under the brand Royal IHC, and the German coating material specialist Sindlhauser Materials. Under these new rules, Chinese suppliers and operators are strictly prohibited from providing these European firms with dual-use goods. RELATED: EU Reaches Deal on 21st Sanctions Package Against Russia These items represent technologies and materials with both civilian and military applications. Furthermore, China banned any foreign organization or individual from transferring or facilitating Chinese-origin dual-use items to the blacklisted corporations. title: 中国企业在非洲最北端修建“幸福桥” _ 调查研究 _ 福建省商务厅
content: 这座桥建于1980年，因高度不足，每天定时关闭，升起桥面以便让船只通行。 旅游旺季时，等待过桥的车辆队伍有数公里之长。 比塞大运河将城市一分为二，很多当地居民为了到达几百米外的运河对岸，不得不绕行60公里。 一直以来，他们都盼望能建一座新桥，解决出行困难。 今年 3月，中国蜀道投资集团下属的四川公路桥梁建设集团有限公司（四川路桥）与突尼斯装备和住房部签约，承建比塞大大桥项目。 突装备和住房部部长曾兹丽当时告诉记者，突方为该项目选择中国企业，是因其具有出色的经验和技术，比塞大居民将在家门口看着这座新桥拔地而起。 日前，记者在工地看到，中国企业在大桥项目红线范围内紧锣密鼓地进行施工，数台钻机正在钻地取样。

title: 全国法院被执行人信息查询 - 被执行人查询
content:
因被执行人未按执行通知书指定的期间履行生效法律文书确定的给付义务，且具有《最高人民法院关于公布失信被执行人名单信息的若干规定》第一条规定的情形，已被纳入失信被执行人名单，依照《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》和《最高人民法院关于限制被执行人高消费的若干规定》等有关规定，特向失信被执行人发出限制消费令。

被执行人为自然人的，被采取限制消费措施后，不得有以下高消费及非生活和工作必需的消费行为：（一）乘坐交通工具时，选择飞机、列车软卧、轮船二等以上舱位；（二）在星级以上宾馆、酒店、夜总会、高尔夫球场等场所进行高消费；（三）购买不动产或者新建、扩建、高档装修房屋；（四）租赁高档写字楼、宾馆、公寓等场所办公；（五）购买非经营必需车辆；（六）旅游、度假；（七）子女就读高收费私立学校；（八）支付高额保费购买保险理财产品；（九）乘坐 G字头动车组列车全部座位、其他动车组列车一等以上座位等其他非生活和工作必需的消费行为。被执行人为单位的，被采取限制消费措施后，被执行人及其法定代表人、主要负责人、影响债务履行的直接责任人员、实际控制人不得实施前述行为。因私消费以个人财产实施前述行为的，可以向执行法院提出申请。 被限制消费的被执行人因生活或者经营必需而进行前述禁止的消费活动的，应当向本院提出申请，获批准后方可进行。

如违反限制消费令，经查证属实的，本院将依照《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第一百一十一条的规定，予以罚款、拘留；情节严重，构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。 人民法院依据《最高人民法院关于公布失信被执行人名单信息的若干规定》第二条第二款的规定，决定提前删除失信信息的；依据《最高人民法院关于公布失信被执行人名单信息的若干规定》第十条第一款第一项、第二项、第三项、第五项、第六项、第七项、第八项和第二款的规定，删除失信信息的，失信被执行人的限制消费令同时解除。

title: 租赁服务协议（旧）
content:
本《悠悠有品租赁服务协议》（下亦简称"本协议"）的订立、履行、解释及争议的解决均适用中华人民共和国法律并排除一切冲突法的适用。

本协议约定了平台所提供的服务、平台交易规则、如何保障用户权益及纠纷的解决方式等问题。请在交易前，详细阅读本协议所有内容。如您为出租方/卖方请代入甲方条款适用，如您为承租方/买方请代入乙方条款适用，丙方为平台方。

本协议约定的交易模式为"可租可售"，即乙方在租赁期间，可以归还租赁的饰品，也可选择购买租赁的饰品。若乙方在租赁到期后未按照本协议约定期限归还饰品，视为乙方买断租赁的饰品。

其他情况：租赁未到协议约定期限，如乙方提前买断，该情况下乙方需承担违约责任，协议租金中（履约日期*当日租金）和押金归属于甲方。"只租不售"模式下，乙方也可能会出现租赁到期后未按照本协议约定期限归还饰品，该情况下乙方需承担违约责任，且视为乙方买断租赁的饰品。

【甲方】是指自愿签署《租赁服务协议》，且已阅览并同意本协议所有条款，认可本协议的法律效力后，通过丙方运营平台出租或出售商品的用户。

【乙方】是指自愿签署《租赁服务协议》，且已阅览并同意本协议所有条款，认可本协议的法律效力后，通过丙方运营平台下单租用或者购买甲方商品的用户。

【丙方】是负责为本协议项下的租赁服务提供系统支持及信息技术支持等服务的网络交易平台。是为甲乙双方提供技术和服务支持的在线交易平台，该平台名为"悠悠有品平台"由郑州市中奥信息技术有限公司开发运营。

1.在此特别提示您阅读本协议的各个条款，尤其是以粗体 、下划线 等标示的条款，包括但不限于第【六】条违约的处理、第【十】条失信租户的处理、第【十二】条争议解决条款、第【十三】条合同效力、第【十四】条通知及送达条款及附件一《个人信息查询授权书》等可能限制或影响您责任的相应条款。甲方及丙方通过本协议向乙方提供租赁服务，如乙方通过点击确认、勾选同意等方式在平台或其他客户端确认本协议，或通过电子签名的方式在电子合同平台签署本协议，即视为乙方已阅读并同意本协议所有条款，且对本协议条款的含义及相应的法律后果已全部通晓并充分理解，同意接受本协议的约束。

2.甲方确认并承诺：甲方已明确知晓使用悠悠有品平台的交易规则，同意并认可出租的饰品"可租可售"的交易模式；甲方知晓并同意丙方可根据乙方信用资质授予其免押额度；丙方按照本协议约定向乙方主张权益时，如需甲方配合，甲方应予以积极配合；

3.乙方确认并承诺:乙方已明确知晓乙方登陆悠悠有品平台前已同意授权悠悠有品获取乙方的支付宝账号信息，使用该支付宝账号在悠悠有品平台进行的任意行为均视为乙方本人的行为(包括但不限于签署本协议、申请免押等行为 )，乙方对上述行为承担一切责任及法律后果；乙方同意并认可承租的饰品"可租可售"的交易模式，在其逾期三日以上，视为乙方同意无条件买断承租饰品。

4.如果您不同意本协议的任意内容，或者无法准确理解本协议相关条款，请不要进行后续操作。如您对本协议有任何疑问，确认签署本协议之前请联系平台官方客服进行咨询，悠悠有品客服将竭诚为您服务并作出解释。

5.丙方运营悠悠有品平台的网站、手机app、小程序、H5页面显示的商品或服务信息随时都有可能发生变动，丙方运营悠悠有品平台的网站、手机app、小程序、H5页面中的文字表述、图片效果可能被实时修改和调整，对于此类变化和调整，丙方可能无法及时作特别通知。丙方运营悠悠有品平台的网站、手机app、微信小程序、H5页面内展示的标的物规格、参数、库存、等商品信息将尽可能准确、详细并与实际产品信息相匹配，但由于网站上商品信息的数量极其庞大，且受互联网技术发展水平(如网络延迟、设备配置)等因素的限制，丙方运营悠悠有品平台的网站、手机app、微信小程序、H5页面等不排除部分信息会存在滞后或差错的可能性。甲方、乙方确认:对此情形您表示知悉并理解，并同意不追究丙方的相关责任。

6.本协议签订于郑州高新技术产业开发区。如各方就本协议的内容或其执行发生任何争议（包括但不限于协议或者其他财产性权益纠纷），各方应友好协商解决；协商不成时，各方同意交由本协议签订地有管辖权的人民法院管辖并处理。

1.1 Steam 是游戏和软件平台。玩家可以在该平台购买、下载、社区讨论、上传和分享游戏和软件。

1.2 CSGO 全称《反恐精英：全球攻势》（ Counter-Strike: Global Offensive ）是Steam平台上的一款第一人称射击游戏。

1.3 饰品 是指CSGO游戏内所存在的、可在steam平台内的不同账号之间流转的游戏角色、游戏资源、游戏道具等可归属于特定主体的财产或财产性权益（包括但不限于游戏中的武器、装备、皮肤等），在本协议中，也可用"商品"来指代饰品。

本协议以及悠悠有品平台相关页面中所描述的"租赁"、 "免押租"、 "租"、 "出租"、 "交易"等用词，均指且仅指前述财产或财产性权益及其交易对价在特定主体之间的流转行为。

content: 亲历了克鲁维齐最后一波矿建潮，到24年我离开刚果（金）时，眼看着当地已经开始配合美国的合作协议对中资企业下狠手了。原本中资在当地本身都是与吉卡明合资的项目，结果人家借着这层关系，锁死华刚账户、卡住进口清关、限制洛钼TFM出口，甚至直接把中资近半的产能调拨到美方的协议框架 ...

content: 2026年7月28日，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）有效禁止进口新的外国制造的人形机器人，四足机器人（“机器狗”）和电源逆变器。这项禁令适用于新型号，不影响已经授权的现有型号，将这些产品添加到FCC的“涵盖清单”中的设备被认为对美国市场风险太大。这意味着他们不能获得在美国销售所需的FCC设备授权。为什么禁止发布？美国政府列举了两个主要原因：1.国家安全和网络安全风险：FCC认为，这些先进的互联网连接机器可能被外国行为者用于间谍活动，数据收集或远程接管。同样，电源逆变器被视为电网中的脆弱点，可能被网络攻击利用。2.保护美国人工智能供应链：特朗普政府将此举视为确保美国关键供应链安全和减少对中国技术依赖的一种方式。它旨在“回流”机器人和人工智能行业。实际效果是，中国公司主导着全球人形机器人市场，估计占85%的份额。

title: 以色列定居者袭击恐吓西岸最后一个全基督教村庄（视频）
content:
RT的夏洛特·杜本斯基访问了Kaa'bneh一家，这是巴勒斯坦贝都因人社区的一部分，居住在拉马拉以东的Taybeh，她目睹了定居者在日落时分带着绵羊和山羊接近，投掷石块，并试图突破围栏。这家人说，这样的入侵每天可能发生好几次。

“他们来破坏我们的财产，割断围栏，把羊群带到我们的土地上，”纳伊夫·卡布内说。“他们打破水箱，切断电源。如果有人在拍摄，他们就会殴打他们。”

卡巴内说，这种骚扰已经持续了好几年，最近又加剧了。他指责以色列军方不采取行动，让定居者几乎完全不受惩罚。他说，军队可能要花几个小时才能对袭击作出反应，而且从来没有拘留过肇事者。

他说：“他们从来没有来逮捕过一个定居者。我们告诉他们，'定居者在那里。'士兵只是转过头，假装什么也没看到，然后他们就离开了。”

与此同时，当地人说，新的定居者前哨出现在泰贝赫周围的山上，加剧了人们的担忧，即居民正被不断包围，并被赶出他们世代居住的土地。

excerpt: Settler incursions and Israeli military restrictions are making life untenable in the Christian village of Taybeh, residents tell RT Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
RT's Charlotte Dubenskij visited the Kaa'bneh family, part of a Palestinian Bedouin community living in Taybeh, east of Ramallah, where she witnessed settlers approaching with sheep and goats at sunset, hurling rocks, and trying to breach the fences. The family says such incursions can happen several times a day.

"They come and vandalize our property, cut through the fencing and bring their sheep onto our land," Naif Kaa'bneh said. "They break the water tanks and cut off the electricity. If someone is filming, they beat them."

Kaa'bneh said the harassment has continued for years but intensified recently, blaming Israeli military inaction for allowing settlers to act with near-total impunity. He said troops can take hours to respond to attacks and have never detained those responsible.

"They have never once come and arrested a settler. We tell them, 'There's the settler.' The soldier just turns his head, pretends he hasn't seen anything, and they leave," he said.

Meanwhile, locals say new settler outposts are appearing on the hills around Taybeh, fueling fears that residents are being steadily hemmed in and pushed from land they have inhabited for generations.

title: 西班牙移民聚集的飞地报道了至少15起强奸案-媒体
content:
文件照片：2026年7月31日，数十名移民从摩洛哥游到西班牙休达后在街上过夜。© Getty Images / Marcos Moreno/Europa Press《世界报》周日援引西班牙国家宪兵队的话说，自7月下旬移民大量涌入以来，西班牙北非飞地休达至少发生了15起强奸案。

这场危机爆发于7月30日至31日，当时估计有7.2万名移民进入休达。据报道，尽管许多人已经返回，但入侵给休达的基础设施带来了沉重的压力。政府数据显示，这座小城市去年的人口约为8.4万。

据报道，至少有四名14岁以下的移民女孩因涉嫌性侵犯而接受治疗。

休达危机也加剧了欧盟内部的紧张局势，并引发了欧洲政界人士对西班牙宽松移民政策的批评。欧盟22个国家的领导人在8月初签署了一封信，指责马德里破坏了欧盟的安全，而一些国家呼吁将西班牙排除在申根无国界旅行区之外。

西班牙首相桑切斯（Pedro Sanchez）驳斥了批评，称欧盟联名信“自私、两极分化和非法”，并坚称当前的危机不是马德里整体移民政策的后果。

excerpt: At least 15 rape cases have been recorded during the Ceuta migrant crisis, El Mundo reported, citing Spain’s Civil Guard Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
FILE PHOTO: Dozens of migrants spend the night on the streets after swimming from Morocco to Ceuta, Spain, 31 July, 2026. © Getty Images / Marcos Moreno/Europa Press At least 15 cases of rape have been recorded in the Spanish North African enclave of Ceuta since it was swarmed by the massive influx of migrants in late July, El Mundo reported on Sunday, citing Spain's national gendarmerie.

The crisis erupted on July 30-31 when an estimated 72,000 migrants entered Ceuta. While many have already reportedly returned, the invasion has put heavy pressure on infrastructure in Ceuta, a small city whose population was around 84,000 as of last year, according to government data.

This came after at least four migrant girls under 14 have reportedly been treated for alleged sexual assaults.

The Ceuta crisis has also fueled tensions within the EU and triggered criticism of Spain's lax immigration policies from politicians across Europe. The leaders of 22 EU nations signed a letter accusing Madrid of undermining the bloc's security in early August, while several countries called for Spain to be excluded from the Schengen borderless travel zone.

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has rejected criticism, calling the joint EU letter " selfish, polarizing and unlawful" and insisting that the current crisis was not a consequence of Madrid's overall migration policies.

title: 以色列的袭击使黎巴嫩陷入更深的经济危机（视频）
content:
RT记者史蒂夫·斯威尼（Steve Sweeney）在贝鲁特报道，随着以色列袭击摧毁房屋和农田，黎巴嫩长期的金融危机不断加深，黎巴嫩家庭正在努力维持生计。

据世界银行估计，2月份汽油价格飙升约25%，而食品和租金成本去年飙升约20%，这给一个超过三分之一人口生活在贫困线以下的国家增加了压力。

斯威尼报道说，许多黎巴嫩人也在努力解决拖欠工资的问题。

一位当地出租车司机对RT电视台说：“如果经济形势继续下去，我告诉你，社会将发生爆炸。人们将相互对立，因为当绝食抗议时，边界就会消失。”黎巴嫩“活在借来的时间里”，依赖国际社会的决定和基本必需品的援助。

黎巴嫩的经济危机可以追溯到2019年的金融崩溃。由于以色列的战争和对该国南部部分地区的持续占领，其经济进一步紧张。

据报道，自6月17日与真主党停火以来，以色列国防军故意在黎巴嫩南部的林地、农田和格罗夫斯中点燃野火。

excerpt: Lebanon’s economic crisis is squeezing families as Israeli attacks destroy homes and farmland in the south, RT reports from Beirut Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
© RT Lebanese families are struggling to make ends meet as the country's long-running financial crisis deepens amid Israeli attacks that have devastated homes and farmland, RT correspondent Steve Sweeney reports from Beirut.

Gasoline prices soared by around 25% in February, while food and rent costs spiked by around 20% last year, adding pressure in a country where more than a third of the population lives below the poverty line, according to World Bank estimates.

Many Lebanese are also grappling with unpaid wages, Sweeney reports.

"If the economic situation continues as it is, I'm telling you, there will be a social explosion. People will turn against one another because when hunger strikes, boundaries disappear," a local taxi driver told RT. Lebanon is "living on borrowed time," dependent on international decisions and aid for basic necessities, added.

Lebanon's economic crisis dates back to its 2019 financial collapse. Its economy has come under further strain from Israel's war and continuing occupation of parts of the south of the country.

IDF have reportedly deliberately ignited wildfires in woodland, farmland, and olive groves in southern Lebanon since the June 17 ceasefire with Hezbollah.

title: 印度尼西亚发生7.7级地震，至少造成5人死亡（视频）
content:
当地时间周六早上6点前，印度尼西亚海岸发生7.7级强烈地震，建筑物受损，引发海啸。据初步报告，至少有5人死亡。

印尼气象、气候和地球物理局（BMKG）称，地震震中位于印尼东部Mbay东北约30公里（18.6英里）处的海底。

据美国地质调查局（USGS）报道，据报道，多个地区发生了高达0.94米的海啸。

东南部东努沙登加拉省省长梅尔基·拉卡·莱纳在媒体援引的一份声明中说，至少有5人死亡。

社交媒体上流传的视频据称捕捉到了地震，显示建筑物的外墙在惊恐的人们逃离时倒塌。

其他画面显示建筑物已经完全倒塌。

印度尼西亚是一个由数千个岛屿组成的庞大群岛，位于几个主要构造板块的交汇点，沿着地球上地震最活跃的地区之一的太平洋火环。

近几十年来，该国一直面临着毁灭性的地震，包括2004年发生的9.1级毁灭性地震，造成更广泛地区的22万多人死亡。

最近，2018年印度尼西亚中南部龙目岛发生6.9级地震，造成数百人死亡。

excerpt: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia on Saturday, triggering tsunami waves and damaging buildings Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
A massive 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia just before 6 AM local time on Saturday, damaging buildings causing a tsunami. At least five people were killed, according to preliminary reports.

The earthquake's epicenter hit the seafloor around 30 kilometers (18.6 miles) northeast of Mbay in eastern Indonesia, the country's Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) said.

Tsunami waves up to 0.94 meters tall were reported in several regions, according to the agency. Three aftershocks of magnitudes 5.6, 6.1 and 5 followed the initial quake, the US Geological Survey (USGS) reported.

At least five people were killed, Melki Laka Lena, governor of the southeastern province of East Nusa Tenggara, said in a statement cited by the media.

Videos circulating on social media, purportedly capturing the earthquake, show building facades crumbling as terrified people flee.

Other footage shows buildings that had entirely collapsed.

Indonesia, a vast archipelago of thousands of islands, sits at the meeting point of several major tectonic plates and lies along the Pacific Ring of Fire, one of the most seismically active regions on Earth.

The country has faced devastating earthquakes in recent decades, including a devastating 9.1 magnitude event in 2004, which killed more than 220,000 people in the broader region.

Most recently, hundreds were killed by a 6.9 magnitude earthquake in Lombok in south-central Indonesia in 2018.

title: 崩溃和微薄的饭菜：袭击伊朗的美国航母上的情况有多糟糕？
content:
2006年5月8日，尼米兹级航空母舰亚伯拉罕林肯号和第二航空联队的飞机在南中国海进行空中表演。© Getty Images / Stocktrek Images亚伯拉罕林肯号在美国和以色列对伊朗的战争期间，在越来越多的关于严重疲惫，供应短缺，以及机组人员的心理健康问题。这些问题在机组人员的家属中引发了轩然大波，并促使美国立法者对此做出回应。

该舰是一艘可容纳5,000人的尼米兹级核动力航空母舰，最多可搭载90架飞机，在最高能力下，每天可执行100多架次战斗任务。该舰于11月下旬离开圣地亚哥。它目前已部署了260多天，包括连续200多天的海上部署--按照海军的标准，这是一个非同寻常的时间段。

除此之外，这艘航母大部分时间都处于作战环境中，伊朗声称曾多次将其作为目标。尽管美国官员坚称这艘航母仍在运营，但长期作战的艰难似乎正在造成损失。

以下是我们对航母及其船员面临的问题的了解。

亚伯拉罕林肯号上的情况如何？

机组人员及其家属的抱怨远远超出了长期部署的通常不适。

这些问题包括牙膏、除臭剂和肥皂短缺、热水和饮用水问题、厕所破损、洗衣设施不可靠、食品供应中断、邮件延误严重，据报道，一些护理包在系统中消失了几个月。其他报告描述了霉菌、管道故障以及飞行甲板因长期使用而没有进行适当维修而磨损的部分洞。

民主党众议员迈克·莱文（Mike Levin）声称，食物状况非常糟糕，机组人员的膳食“下降到半杯米饭和两个玉米饼”。

excerpt: USS Abraham Lincoln has reportedly come close to the breaking point as its crew struggles with supply shortages and mental exhaustion Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
The Nimitz Class Carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, and aircraft from Carrier Air Wing 2 perform an aerial demonstration in the South China Sea, on May 8, 2006. © Getty Images / Stocktrek Images The USS Abraham Lincoln has been grappling with dismal conditions for months during the US-Israeli war on Iran, amid mounting reports of severe exhaustion, supply shortages, and mental-health problems among crew members. The problems have sparked an uproar among crew members' families and prompted demands for answers from US lawmakers.

The vessel, a 5,000-person nuclear-powered Nimitz-class aircraft carrier capable of carrying up to 90 aircraft and conducting more than 100 combat sorties a day at peak capacity, left San Diego in late November. It has now been deployed for more than 260 days, including more than 200 consecutive days at sea – an extraordinary stretch by Navy standards.

On top of that, the flattop has spent much of that time in a combat environment, with Iran claiming to have targeted it on numerous occasions. Even as US officials insist the carrier remains operational, the hardships of a prolonged campaign appear to be taking their toll.

Here is what we know about the issues facing the aircraft carrier and its crew.

What are conditions like aboard the Abraham Lincoln?

The complaints from crew members and their families go well beyond the usual discomforts of a long deployment.

They include shortages of toothpaste, deodorant, and soap, problems with hot and potable water, broken toilets, unreliable laundry facilities, disruptions to food supplies, and mail delays so severe that some care packages reportedly disappeared into the system for months. Other reports describe mold, failing plumbing, and holes worn through parts of the flight deck from extensive use without adequate repairs.

© USA Today / Screenshot Democratic Congressman Mike Levin claimed that the food situation is so bad that crew members' meals "came down to half a cup of rice and two tortillas." The meager meals were first reported by USA Today as early as mid-April, although the Pentagon denied that there were food shortages at the time.

The USS Abraham Lincoln has been at sea for more than 250 days, pushing its crew to the limit. Sailors report exhaustion, deteriorating living conditions, shortages of basic supplies and serious food problems: small portions, poor-quality meals and periods of depleted stocks. The… https://t.co/iWYaeKchzU pic.twitter.com/C4cheR4N2M — Tom Antonov (@Tom_Antonov) August 13, 2026

According to Maritime Executive, the supply problems are partly due to logistics, as the main base of the 5th Fleet is located in Bahrain, deep inside the Persian Gulf, meaning many shipments must pass through the Strait of Hormuz and risk Iranian strikes.

There are strong indications that it is. One of the most striking episodes confirmed by CENTCOM occurred on August 3, when a sailor went overboard from the Abraham Lincoln and was recovered roughly an hour later.

excerpt: US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, has branded Israeli settlers besieging several Palestinian homes in the West Bank “terrorists” Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee. © Global Look Press / Keystone Press Agency / Will Oliver - Pool via CNP US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has branded Israeli settlers besieging three Palestinian families in their West Bank homes "terrorists." The days-long siege has targeted several properties, including one owned by a dual US citizen. According to the UN, the blockade in the village of Qusra began last Sunday, leaving approximately 15 Palestinians, including at least two children, trapped in their homes without access to electricity or water supplies. The Palestinians are also believed to be running out of food and medicine. Huckabee, known for his pro-Israel views and support for the settler movement, issued the rare rebuke in a post on X on Thursday. "The actions of those doing this to this family's home is criminal… Actions by those who carried out this horrific act of terror meant to intimidate and harass this family are disgusting. No excuse for such thuggish behavior," the diplomat wrote. The US envoy also claimed that the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and the police had removed the "Israeli terrorists" from Qusra at the US Embassy's request.

特朗普周二承认换了飞机，坚称自己只是在做特勤局认为最好的行动。“我经过特勤局和军方。他们想让我换一个航班，换一架飞机。我只需要按他们说的去做，”特朗普告诉记者。

Air Force One sits on the tarmac with an airport catering container adjacent to the body of the aircraft in Ankara, Türkiye on July 08, 2026. © Getty Images / Win McNamee The US intelligence community doubted reports of an Iranian plot to kill President Donald Trump by shooting down Air Force One as it departed a NATO summit in Türkiye, the Washington Post has reported. Their assessment was reportedly conveyed to the administration, yet the Secret Service still opted to covertly move Trump to another aircraft.

US media broke the story of the clandestine maneuver this Monday. On leaving the meeting, Trump abruptly switched from his new Qatari-gifted Boeing 747-8 to the previous Air Force One, but it turned out he secretly left that aircraft as well in an airport catering truck, flying aboard a smaller military plane to the UK. He is said to have reboarded the older Air Force One there to create the impression that he was on it the entire time.

CIA analysts were highly skeptical of intelligence on an imminent assassination plot and conveyed that position to the administration. Reports about the threat were "Israeli-derived, not US-generated, and viewed as low confidence," an unnamed intel official told the Post.

Trump admitted to switching planes on Tuesday, insisting he was only doing what the Secret Service considered the best course of action. "I go by Secret Service and the military. They wanted me to go in a different flight, different plane. I just have to do what they say," Trump told reporters.

The scandal also coincides with the departure of White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, who announced on Wednesday she would leave her position at the end of the month "so she can spend more time" with her family. The 28-year-old, who became a mother for the second time in May, returned to the White House after a hiatus in June. Leavitt's abrupt departure has sprouted theories that she was among the unwitting officials left on the decoy aircraft and that the affair may have been the final straw for her.

excerpt: From counterterrorism to trade corridors, Moscow and Islamabad are turning steady contact into a deeper, more durable relationship Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
For the better part of a decade, Pakistan and Russia have been developing this kind of trust. In the summer of 2026, there were a number of quiet episodes in quick succession that essentially focused on security, diplomacy, energy, education, and trade, with Afghanistan running through almost all of them as a shared concern.

On June 23, Russian and Pakistani officials gathered in Islamabad for the 12th edition of their Joint Working Group on Countering International Terrorism, led by Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Dmitry Lyubinsky and Pakistan's additional foreign secretary, Ambassador Khalid Jamali. The discussion focused on regional terrorist threats, with a particular emphasis on those originating in Afghanistan. The 12th such meeting – a number which indicates that the relationship is designed not for headlines, but for continuity, the kind that can withstand changes in government and the overall geopolitical climate. The two parties agreed that further intelligence sharing and international cooperation would be critical.

Let us get the practical logic right: Bilateral channels like this one fill a void that slower, more bureaucratic multilateral organizations like the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and the UN cannot cover on their own. Pakistan values Russia's counterterrorism experience, particularly in urban warfare and counterinsurgency, while Russia is interested in Pakistan's own operational experience along its western border. It is not a formal alliance, but it benefits both parties.

A few weeks earlier, the two countries' interior ministries had already been busy. On June 6, Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi met his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Kolokoltsev, on the sidelines of an SCO gathering in Bishkek, signing agreements on curbing illegal immigration, repatriating citizens, and countering narcotics trafficking. It wasn't bilateral-only: Naqvi held similar meetings that week with the interior ministers of Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan. Pakistan used a regional platform to navigate several bilateral conversations in a few days. One element is worth noting: Participating ministers estimated that approximately 25 terrorist organizations are now functioning in Afghanistan. That single figure explains why Islamabad and Moscow continue to find reasons to communicate more effectively than any communiqué wording about "shared concerns" can.

Where the two countries converge is on engagement rather than isolation as the way to manage that risk. In April 2025, Russia removed the Taliban from its list of designated terrorist organizations, and in July 2025 it went further, becoming the first country to formally recognize the Taliban administration as Afghanistan's government. This was a historically loaded step, given that the Soviet Union fought and lost a nine-year war there against the mujahedin forebears of today's Taliban. Moscow's own explanation leaned on both security and economics: continued cooperation on counterterrorism and counter-narcotics, alongside stated interest in energy, transport, agriculture, and infrastructure projects inside Afghanistan. That recognition was formalized furt…

title: 美国公司在工人警告逃离哥伦比亚地震后受到攻击（视频）
content:
哥伦比亚，2026年8月11日。© Getty Images / Gabriel Aponte / Stringer一家美国医疗保健公司在哥伦比亚业务的一名经理被拍到警告员工，他们可能会面临在致命地震期间离开工作岗位的后果后，受到抨击。

哥伦比亚西部星期一发生7.4级地震，造成200多人死亡，数千人失踪。几个城市的建筑物倒塌，基础设施受损，促使政府宣布全国性灾难。

穆尼奥斯说：“我不会命令你离开：谁想离开都可以离开，但如果今天什么都没有发生，你将不得不为放弃你的职位负责。”

据La Razon报道，这段视频在网上引发了批评，用户指责该公司虐待员工，并在其谷歌个人资料中充斥负面评论。

“这不能不受惩罚，”Sanguino在X上写道，敦促当局向工人提供援助。

据Tipnes说，在场的雇员被疏散，大楼在工作人员返回工作岗位前被检查。

fullText:
Colombia, August 11, 2026. © Getty Images / Gabriel Aponte / Stringer A US healthcare company has come under fire after a manager at its Colombian operation was filmed warning employees that they could face consequences for leaving work during the deadly earthquake.

The 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on Monday, killing more than 200 people and leaving thousands missing. Buildings collapsed and infrastructure was damaged across several cities, prompting the government to declare a national disaster.

"I'm not going to give you the order to leave: whoever wants to leave can leave, but if nothing happens today, you will have to answer for abandoning your post," Munoz is heard saying.

🇨🇴🚨 INDIGNANTE: ¡No los dejaron evacuar tras el terremoto! La empresa Blackstone Medical Services Colombia ha generado polémica luego de que se viralizara la respuesta de un jefe a sus empleados. Trabajadores denuncian que fueron amenazados con ser despedidos por “abandono… pic.twitter.com/rzHDnbmjji — Alerta Mundial (@AlertaMundoNews) August 11, 2026

The footage prompted criticism online, with users accusing the company of mistreating staff and flooding its Google profile with negative reviews, La Razon reported.

"This cannot go unpunished," Sanguino wrote on X, urging the authorities to provide assistance to the workers.

According to Tipnes, the employees who were present were evacuated and the building was inspected before staff returned to work.

Blackstone Medical Services is a US healthcare company headquartered in Tampa, Florida. Founded in 2012, it specializes in home testing for obstructive sleep apnea. Its Colombian operation provides clinical and administrative support to the company's US business, including customer service, sales, logistics, medical authorizations, and collections.

title: 伊拉克埃及接连遇袭，美伊僵局下中东战火为何越烧越大？
content:
沙特与美国7月29日打击了伊朗在伊拉克的代理组织；一艘停泊在埃及的天然气储存船疑似遭到无人机袭击而起火；乌克兰和伊朗之间的紧张局势也在加剧……随着美伊战事陷入打打停停的僵局，中东的冲突范围正在扩大。

据新华社报道，美军中央司令部当地时间29日在社交媒体发布声明说，美军于美国东部时间29日22时完成对伊朗的最新一轮大规模打击。此次打击持续两个小时，是对伊朗前一天企图袭击驻中东美军作出的回应。

当天，埃及地中海港口达米埃塔的一处天然气装卸港发生爆炸，据英国海事安全公司安布雷（Ambrey）报告，一架无人机击中了一艘美国所有的天然气浮式储油轮。港口服务公司英之杰（Inchcape）在另一份声明中表示，两艘船只在达米埃塔起火。这是战争爆发以来埃及首次遭受袭击，目前尚不清楚无人机的来源。伊朗官方媒体此前曾将达米埃塔列为针对“乌克兰利益”进行报复的可能目标。

28日，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队证实，该国向约旦穆瓦法克·萨尔蒂空军基地发射了弹道导弹。约旦军方称，已拦截并摧毁了五枚伊朗导弹，没有人员伤亡或财产损失的报告。美国总统 特朗普 随后于29日宣称，美国将“狠狠打击伊朗”。

受到中东地区冲突的影响，国际油价29日再次飙升，创下这场战争爆发以来的最大涨幅之一。布伦特原油期货价格上涨超过8%，推动基准油价超每桶90美元。

在经历了数日的相对平静之后，中东地区多条战线再次爆发冲突，增加了全面战争重燃的风险。英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔警告称，美国和沙特对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵组织的袭击，已将中东地区推入“未知领域”。

当地时间2026年7月29日，伊朗德黑兰，武装部队在阿扎迪纪念碑前的临时展览中展示国产“佐勒法加尔”和“佐勒法加尔·巴西尔”导弹。视觉中国 图

伊拉克成为了本轮冲突外溢中最新一个被打击的对象。

伊拉克国家安全委员会30日发表声明，谴责美国和沙特此前一天对伊拉克人民动员部队（PMF）发动的袭击。声明表示，美沙两国的袭击是一场“侵略行为”，伊拉克“在任何情况下都绝不容忍”。人民动员部队表示，此次袭击代表着“高度危险的局势升级”。伊拉克总理扎伊迪取消了原定于30日访问沙特的计划。

美国和沙特29日对伊拉克7个省份的人民动员部队基地发动袭击，造成至少20名成员死亡，32人受伤。美军中央司令部和沙特表示，空袭的目标是伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织，这些组织应对袭击美军和沙特能源基础设施负责。据伊朗和伊拉克媒体报道，至少有4名伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队顾问在袭击中丧生。

近几日来，沙特方面指责伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织对沙特发动了袭击。根据沙特国防部的声明，沙特防空部队在27日和28日“拦截并摧毁了数架试图袭击东部省和利雅得地区石油设施的无人机……这些无人机是从伊拉克境内发射的，由与伊朗结盟的民兵组织实施的”。沙特国防部强调，该国不寻求局势升级，但“会对任何面临的侵略行为作出回应”。

伊拉克军方否认了沙特方面的说法。伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人表示，没有任何一方向伊拉克方面提供有关袭击是从伊拉克发动的证据，而美国和沙特的“侵略行为阻碍了对沙特涉嫌遭受攻击的调查工作”。

相关组织伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动称沙特的说法是“捏造的”，并表示“任何愚蠢的沙特行动都将受到严厉的回应”。该组织同时指责沙特方面的指控是“为沙特无力应对也门胡塞武装近期对沙特的袭击辩解”。

伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动成员“真主党旅”在一份声明中发出警告，要求伊拉克政府在8月6日前证明其有能力捍卫主权。该组织还表示，对美国和沙特发动的袭击做出立即回应是“不可避免的”。

人民动员部队成立于2014年，是伊拉克武装部队的一部分，下辖许多伊拉克什叶派民兵组织，其中多个组织获得了伊朗的支持。伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动是一个松散的武装组织联盟，由多个亲伊朗的人民动员部队单位联合而成。

人民动员部队问题一直是伊拉克政府与美国及其他邻国之间争论的焦点，伊拉克政府无法有效约束该组织下辖的武装组织，这些组织此前曾自行对伊拉克境内驻有美军的基地以及美国驻伊拉克外交设施发动袭击。

沙特与美国联合打击伊拉克，再次凸显了沙特面临的安全困境。据美国Axios新闻网站报道，沙特国防大臣哈立德·本-萨勒曼亲王29日与美国副总统万斯举行了紧急会晤。

报道援引消息人士的话报道，哈立德向万斯传达了沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德·本-萨勒曼的信息，称沙特对伊拉克的空袭并不意味着支持局势升级，该国仍倾向于与伊朗缓和局势。哈立德同时表示，沙特方面能够处理与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势，目前不需要美国介入。

美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）分析指出，沙特此前曾极力避免被卷入地区冲突，但目前正陷入伊朗及其盟友的包围和夹击中，同时面临3个方向的威胁：伊朗、也门胡塞武装，以及伊拉克什叶派民兵。

近两周来，沙特与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势急剧升级。7月20日，胡塞武装宣布对红海的沙特船只实施海上封锁。沙特24日对胡塞武装控制的荷台达发动了空袭，胡塞武装次日使用导弹和无人机袭击了沙特西南部城市贾赞的能源基础设施。

据路透社29日援引消息人士的话报道，为回应胡塞武装对沙特的封锁，沙特正寻求建立一个国际联盟保护红海航运。消息人士表示，该联盟的组成尚未最终确定，目前正在与数十个国家进行磋商。

不仅如此，据卡塔尔半岛电视台本周报道，在胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府军爆发多起小规模冲突后，双方正在进行军事动员。

对于沙特而言，由于霍尔木兹海峡航运仍然事实上关闭，该国已将大部分石油出口改道至红海港口延布。在此情况下，胡塞武装在曼德海峡针对沙特船只的封锁将对沙特的能源出口造成重大干扰。分析人士穆罕默德·巴沙对此指出：“（沙特的）所有红线都被突破了，所有按钮都被胡塞武装按下了。”

英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔指出，沙特近期的行动旨在恢复对伊朗的威慑。“从沙特的角度来看，他们觉得伊朗之所以采取这些行动，是因为他们认为海湾阿拉伯国家不会进一步升级冲突。沙特想要明确表明伊朗的这种评估是错误的。”

然而，沙特也同样面临巨大的安全和经济风险。赫利尔指出，沙特方面无法预料对方可能的回应，该地区也因此身处“未知领域”。CNN指出，沙特在过去十年一直致力于吸引外资并成为地区经济强国，但卷入地区冲突将“成为一场噩梦”。

今年第一季度，由于大幅增加支出以抵消战争和经济增长乏力的影响，沙特录得了自2018年以来最大的季度财政赤字，该国的许多大型项目被迫缩减规模。

卡内基国际和平基金会中东项目非常驻学者安德鲁·莱伯表示，沙特决定对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵发动袭击，而非直接打击伊朗，表明沙特仍在避免全面卷入战争。“沙特表示他们仍然愿意达成协议，同时发出明确信号，表明他们的耐心并非无限。”

在美以伊战争期间，伊朗曾使用“沙赫德”无人机袭击沙特东海岸的石油设施，作为报复，沙特对伊朗展开了有限的空袭行动。伊朗外交部本周警告称：“一些波斯湾国家独立参与了对伊朗的军事袭击，美国应对这些袭击负责，但一些地区国家的角色也不容忽视。”

伊朗28日先发制人发动对美国军事基地的打击行动，打破了中东地区数日来的相对平静，也改变了该地区的冲突模式。

美国中东研究所高级研究员杰森·坎贝尔指出，伊朗此举旨在表明，他们“不会坐等美国或以色列在他们想要的时候发动袭击”，而是试图掌握主动权，或者至少“让美国和以色列处于被动局面”。

德国国际与安全事务研究所的研究员哈米德·雷扎·阿齐兹在社交平台X上表示：“伊朗的做法似乎发生了根本性的变化，尤其是在它认为发动打击是唯一可行的选择时。”

此举反过来又为局势新一轮升级埋下了伏笔。特朗普29日向福克斯新闻表示：“我们要狠狠揍他们一顿。”美国随后于30日对伊朗发动打击。

fullText:
沙特与美国7月29日打击了伊朗在伊拉克的代理组织；一艘停泊在埃及的天然气储存船疑似遭到无人机袭击而起火；乌克兰和伊朗之间的紧张局势也在加剧……随着美伊战事陷入打打停停的僵局，中东的冲突范围正在扩大。

据新华社报道，美军中央司令部当地时间29日在社交媒体发布声明说，美军于美国东部时间29日22时完成对伊朗的最新一轮大规模打击。此次打击持续两个小时，是对伊朗前一天企图袭击驻中东美军作出的回应。

当天，埃及地中海港口达米埃塔的一处天然气装卸港发生爆炸，据英国海事安全公司安布雷（Ambrey）报告，一架无人机击中了一艘美国所有的天然气浮式储油轮。港口服务公司英之杰（Inchcape）在另一份声明中表示，两艘船只在达米埃塔起火。这是战争爆发以来埃及首次遭受袭击，目前尚不清楚无人机的来源。伊朗官方媒体此前曾将达米埃塔列为针对“乌克兰利益”进行报复的可能目标。

28日，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队证实，该国向约旦穆瓦法克·萨尔蒂空军基地发射了弹道导弹。约旦军方称，已拦截并摧毁了五枚伊朗导弹，没有人员伤亡或财产损失的报告。美国总统 特朗普 随后于29日宣称，美国将“狠狠打击伊朗”。

受到中东地区冲突的影响，国际油价29日再次飙升，创下这场战争爆发以来的最大涨幅之一。布伦特原油期货价格上涨超过8%，推动基准油价超每桶90美元。

在经历了数日的相对平静之后，中东地区多条战线再次爆发冲突，增加了全面战争重燃的风险。英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔警告称，美国和沙特对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵组织的袭击，已将中东地区推入“未知领域”。

当地时间2026年7月29日，伊朗德黑兰，武装部队在阿扎迪纪念碑前的临时展览中展示国产“佐勒法加尔”和“佐勒法加尔·巴西尔”导弹。视觉中国 图

伊拉克成为了本轮冲突外溢中最新一个被打击的对象。

伊拉克国家安全委员会30日发表声明，谴责美国和沙特此前一天对伊拉克人民动员部队（PMF）发动的袭击。声明表示，美沙两国的袭击是一场“侵略行为”，伊拉克“在任何情况下都绝不容忍”。人民动员部队表示，此次袭击代表着“高度危险的局势升级”。伊拉克总理扎伊迪取消了原定于30日访问沙特的计划。

美国和沙特29日对伊拉克7个省份的人民动员部队基地发动袭击，造成至少20名成员死亡，32人受伤。美军中央司令部和沙特表示，空袭的目标是伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织，这些组织应对袭击美军和沙特能源基础设施负责。据伊朗和伊拉克媒体报道，至少有4名伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队顾问在袭击中丧生。

近几日来，沙特方面指责伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织对沙特发动了袭击。根据沙特国防部的声明，沙特防空部队在27日和28日“拦截并摧毁了数架试图袭击东部省和利雅得地区石油设施的无人机……这些无人机是从伊拉克境内发射的，由与伊朗结盟的民兵组织实施的”。沙特国防部强调，该国不寻求局势升级，但“会对任何面临的侵略行为作出回应”。

伊拉克军方否认了沙特方面的说法。伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人表示，没有任何一方向伊拉克方面提供有关袭击是从伊拉克发动的证据，而美国和沙特的“侵略行为阻碍了对沙特涉嫌遭受攻击的调查工作”。

相关组织伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动称沙特的说法是“捏造的”，并表示“任何愚蠢的沙特行动都将受到严厉的回应”。该组织同时指责沙特方面的指控是“为沙特无力应对也门胡塞武装近期对沙特的袭击辩解”。

伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动成员“真主党旅”在一份声明中发出警告，要求伊拉克政府在8月6日前证明其有能力捍卫主权。该组织还表示，对美国和沙特发动的袭击做出立即回应是“不可避免的”。

人民动员部队成立于2014年，是伊拉克武装部队的一部分，下辖许多伊拉克什叶派民兵组织，其中多个组织获得了伊朗的支持。伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动是一个松散的武装组织联盟，由多个亲伊朗的人民动员部队单位联合而成。

人民动员部队问题一直是伊拉克政府与美国及其他邻国之间争论的焦点，伊拉克政府无法有效约束该组织下辖的武装组织，这些组织此前曾自行对伊拉克境内驻有美军的基地以及美国驻伊拉克外交设施发动袭击。

沙特与美国联合打击伊拉克，再次凸显了沙特面临的安全困境。据美国Axios新闻网站报道，沙特国防大臣哈立德·本-萨勒曼亲王29日与美国副总统万斯举行了紧急会晤。

报道援引消息人士的话报道，哈立德向万斯传达了沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德·本-萨勒曼的信息，称沙特对伊拉克的空袭并不意味着支持局势升级，该国仍倾向于与伊朗缓和局势。哈立德同时表示，沙特方面能够处理与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势，目前不需要美国介入。

美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）分析指出，沙特此前曾极力避免被卷入地区冲突，但目前正陷入伊朗及其盟友的包围和夹击中，同时面临3个方向的威胁：伊朗、也门胡塞武装，以及伊拉克什叶派民兵。

近两周来，沙特与也门胡塞武装之间的紧张局势急剧升级。7月20日，胡塞武装宣布对红海的沙特船只实施海上封锁。沙特24日对胡塞武装控制的荷台达发动了空袭，胡塞武装次日使用导弹和无人机袭击了沙特西南部城市贾赞的能源基础设施。

据路透社29日援引消息人士的话报道，为回应胡塞武装对沙特的封锁，沙特正寻求建立一个国际联盟保护红海航运。消息人士表示，该联盟的组成尚未最终确定，目前正在与数十个国家进行磋商。

不仅如此，据卡塔尔半岛电视台本周报道，在胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府军爆发多起小规模冲突后，双方正在进行军事动员。

对于沙特而言，由于霍尔木兹海峡航运仍然事实上关闭，该国已将大部分石油出口改道至红海港口延布。在此情况下，胡塞武装在曼德海峡针对沙特船只的封锁将对沙特的能源出口造成重大干扰。分析人士穆罕默德·巴沙对此指出：“（沙特的）所有红线都被突破了，所有按钮都被胡塞武装按下了。”

英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔指出，沙特近期的行动旨在恢复对伊朗的威慑。“从沙特的角度来看，他们觉得伊朗之所以采取这些行动，是因为他们认为海湾阿拉伯国家不会进一步升级冲突。沙特想要明确表明伊朗的这种评估是错误的。”

然而，沙特也同样面临巨大的安全和经济风险。赫利尔指出，沙特方面无法预料对方可能的回应，该地区也因此身处“未知领域”。CNN指出，沙特在过去十年一直致力于吸引外资并成为地区经济强国，但卷入地区冲突将“成为一场噩梦”。

今年第一季度，由于大幅增加支出以抵消战争和经济增长乏力的影响，沙特录得了自2018年以来最大的季度财政赤字，该国的许多大型项目被迫缩减规模。

卡内基国际和平基金会中东项目非常驻学者安德鲁·莱伯表示，沙特决定对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵发动袭击，而非直接打击伊朗，表明沙特仍在避免全面卷入战争。“沙特表示他们仍然愿意达成协议，同时发出明确信号，表明他们的耐心并非无限。”

在美以伊战争期间，伊朗曾使用“沙赫德”无人机袭击沙特东海岸的石油设施，作为报复，沙特对伊朗展开了有限的空袭行动。伊朗外交部本周警告称：“一些波斯湾国家独立参与了对伊朗的军事袭击，美国应对这些袭击负责，但一些地区国家的角色也不容忽视。”

伊朗28日先发制人发动对美国军事基地的打击行动，打破了中东地区数日来的相对平静，也改变了该地区的冲突模式。

美国中东研究所高级研究员杰森·坎贝尔指出，伊朗此举旨在表明，他们“不会坐等美国或以色列在他们想要的时候发动袭击”，而是试图掌握主动权，或者至少“让美国和以色列处于被动局面”。

德国国际与安全事务研究所的研究员哈米德·雷扎·阿齐兹在社交平台X上表示：“伊朗的做法似乎发生了根本性的变化，尤其是在它认为发动打击是唯一可行的选择时。”

此举反过来又为局势新一轮升级埋下了伏笔。特朗普29日向福克斯新闻表示：“我们要狠狠揍他们一顿。”美国随后于30日对伊朗发动打击。

对于沙特而言，由于霍尔木兹海峡航运仍然事实上关闭，该国已将大部分石油出口改道至红海港口延布。在此情况下，胡塞武装在曼德海峡针对沙特船只的封锁将对沙特的能源出口造成重大干扰。分析人士穆罕默德·巴沙对此指出：“（沙特的）所有红线都被突破了，所有按钮都被胡塞武装按下了。”
英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔指出，沙特近期的行动旨在恢复对伊朗的威慑。“从沙特的角度来看，他们觉得伊朗之所以采取这些行动，是因为他们认为海湾阿拉伯国家不会进一步升级冲突。沙特想要明确表明伊朗的这种评估是错误的。”
然而，沙特也同样面临巨大的安全和经济风险。赫利尔指出，沙特方面无法预料对方可能的回应，该地区也因此身处“未知领域”。CNN指出，沙特在过去十年一直致力于吸引外资并成为地区经济强国，但卷入地区冲突将“成为一场噩梦”。
今年第一季度，由于大幅增加支出以抵消战争和经济增长乏力的影响，沙特录得了自2018年以来最大的季度财政赤字，该国的许多大型项目被迫缩减规模。
卡内基国际和平基金会中东项目非常驻学者安德鲁·莱伯表示，沙特决定对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵发动袭击，而非直接打击伊朗，表明沙特仍在避免全面卷入战争。“沙特表示他们仍然愿意达成协议，同时发出明确信号，表明他们的耐心并非无限。”
在美以伊战争期间，伊朗曾使用“沙赫德”无人机袭击沙特东海岸的石油设施，作为报复，沙特对伊朗展开了有限的空袭行动。伊朗外交部本周警告称：“一些波斯湾国家独立参与了对伊朗的军事袭击，美国应对这些袭击负责，但一些地区国家的角色也不容忽视。”
伊朗28日先发制人发动对美国军事基地的打击行动，打破了中东地区数日来的相对平静，也改变了该地区的冲突模式。
美国中东研究所高级研究员杰森·坎贝尔指出，伊朗此举旨在表明，他们“不会坐等美国或以色列在他们想要的时候发动袭击”，而是试图掌握主动权，或者至少“让美国和以色列处于被动局面”。
德国国际与安全事务研究所的研究员哈米德·雷扎·阿齐兹在社交平台X上表示：“伊朗的做法似乎发生了根本性的变化，尤其是在它认为发动打击是唯一可行的选择时。”
此举反过来又为局势新一轮升级埋下了伏笔。特朗普29日向福克斯新闻表示：“我们要狠狠揍他们一顿。”美国随后于30日对伊朗发动打击。
detail:
沙特与美国7月29日打击了伊朗在伊拉克的代理组织；一艘停泊在埃及的天然气储存船疑似遭到无人机袭击而起火；乌克兰和伊朗之间的紧张局势也在加剧……随着美伊战事陷入打打停停的僵局，中东的冲突范围正在扩大。

据新华社报道，美军中央司令部当地时间29日在社交媒体发布声明说，美军于美国东部时间29日22时完成对伊朗的最新一轮大规模打击。此次打击持续两个小时，是对伊朗前一天企图袭击驻中东美军作出的回应。

当天，埃及地中海港口达米埃塔的一处天然气装卸港发生爆炸，据英国海事安全公司安布雷（Ambrey）报告，一架无人机击中了一艘美国所有的天然气浮式储油轮。港口服务公司英之杰（Inchcape）在另一份声明中表示，两艘船只在达米埃塔起火。这是战争爆发以来埃及首次遭受袭击，目前尚不清楚无人机的来源。伊朗官方媒体此前曾将达米埃塔列为针对“乌克兰利益”进行报复的可能目标。

28日，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队证实，该国向约旦穆瓦法克·萨尔蒂空军基地发射了弹道导弹。约旦军方称，已拦截并摧毁了五枚伊朗导弹，没有人员伤亡或财产损失的报告。美国总统 特朗普 随后于29日宣称，美国将“狠狠打击伊朗”。

受到中东地区冲突的影响，国际油价29日再次飙升，创下这场战争爆发以来的最大涨幅之一。布伦特原油期货价格上涨超过8%，推动基准油价超每桶90美元。

在经历了数日的相对平静之后，中东地区多条战线再次爆发冲突，增加了全面战争重燃的风险。英国皇家国际事务研究所中东研究高级研究员H.A.赫利尔警告称，美国和沙特对伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵组织的袭击，已将中东地区推入“未知领域”。

当地时间2026年7月29日，伊朗德黑兰，武装部队在阿扎迪纪念碑前的临时展览中展示国产“佐勒法加尔”和“佐勒法加尔·巴西尔”导弹。视觉中国 图

伊拉克成为了本轮冲突外溢中最新一个被打击的对象。

伊拉克国家安全委员会30日发表声明，谴责美国和沙特此前一天对伊拉克人民动员部队（PMF）发动的袭击。声明表示，美沙两国的袭击是一场“侵略行为”，伊拉克“在任何情况下都绝不容忍”。人民动员部队表示，此次袭击代表着“高度危险的局势升级”。伊拉克总理扎伊迪取消了原定于30日访问沙特的计划。

美国和沙特29日对伊拉克7个省份的人民动员部队基地发动袭击，造成至少20名成员死亡，32人受伤。美军中央司令部和沙特表示，空袭的目标是伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织，这些组织应对袭击美军和沙特能源基础设施负责。据伊朗和伊拉克媒体报道，至少有4名伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队顾问在袭击中丧生。

近几日来，沙特方面指责伊拉克境内受伊朗支持的武装组织对沙特发动了袭击。根据沙特国防部的声明，沙特防空部队在27日和28日“拦截并摧毁了数架试图袭击东部省和利雅得地区石油设施的无人机……这些无人机是从伊拉克境内发射的，由与伊朗结盟的民兵组织实施的”。沙特国防部强调，该国不寻求局势升级，但“会对任何面临的侵略行为作出回应”。

伊拉克军方否认了沙特方面的说法。伊拉克武装部队总司令发言人表示，没有任何一方向伊拉克方面提供有关袭击是从伊拉克发动的证据，而美国和沙特的“侵略行为阻碍了对沙特涉嫌遭受攻击的调查工作”。

相关组织伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动称沙特的说法是“捏造的”，并表示“任何愚蠢的沙特行动都将受到严厉的回应”。该组织同时指责沙特方面的指控是“为沙特无力应对也门胡塞武装近期对沙特的袭击辩解”。

伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动成员“真主党旅”在一份声明中发出警告，要求伊拉克政府在8月6日前证明其有能力捍卫主权。该组织还表示，对美国和沙特发动的袭击做出立即回应是“不可避免的”。

人民动员部队成立于2014年，是伊拉克武装部队的一部分，下辖许多伊拉克什叶派民兵组织，其中多个组织获得了伊朗的支持。伊拉克伊斯兰抵抗运动是一个松散的武装组织联盟，由多个亲伊朗的人民动员部队单位联合而成。

人民动员部队问题一直是伊拉克政府与美国及其他邻国之间争论的焦点，伊拉克政府无法有效约束该组织下辖的武装组织，这些组织此前曾自行对伊拉克境内驻有美军的基地以及美国驻伊拉克外交设施发动袭击。

沙特与美国联合打击伊拉克，再次凸显了沙特面临的安全困境。据美国Axios新闻网站报道，沙特国防大臣哈立德·本-萨勒曼亲王29日与美国副总统万斯举行了紧急会晤。

The German company RWE announced Thursday that it had reached a settlement with the US Department of the Interior to relinquish offshore wind leases off the coasts of New York, California, and Louisiana for $1.22 billion. "After careful consideration, it was determined there is no path forward to permit these projects in the US for the foreseeable future," the firm said in a statement. "The company determined that this resolution best serves the interests of its stakeholders and allows it to direct resources toward energy projects that can be advanced with certainty." RWE also disclosed that it would put $900 million toward an indirect 16% stake in a Louisiana liquefied natural gas project, and $300 million toward turbines for a pipeline of 15 natural gas peaking projects across target US markets. title: 陛下的掠夺：特朗普高速公路和西撒哈拉磷酸盐财富背后的皇家机器
content: 2026年8月3日，特朗普在被占领的西撒哈拉命名一条高速公路，暴露了通过磷酸盐、贸易和占领将摩洛哥、以色列和美国联系在一起的政治、经济和皇家利益网络。撒哈拉有一台机器，你可以从太空中看到。一条传送带，地球上最长的，将近100公里长的钢铁从一个叫布克拉的矿运到大西洋。半个世纪来，它通过战争、停火和从未实现的全民公决，将磷酸盐从被占领的西撒哈拉运出。存款中最丰富的一层已经消失了，在撒哈拉人投票之前就被卖掉了。而维持皮带运转的电力则由国王的一个风力发电场出售给国家。7月26日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，经过这台机器的高速公路现在以他的名字命名。这一宣布是以一个四分钟的Truth Social视频的形式发布的，一个明显的人工智能声音赞扬了他的“历史性勇气”。六天过去了，拉巴特还没有大声说出这个名字。它不需要。这个名字从来都不是报酬。道路是。它是1,055公里长的定居点，横跨非洲的最大城市。

Africa Correspondent – Aug 3, 2026 Trump’s naming of a highway in occupied Western Sahara exposes the network of political, economic, and royal interests linking Morocco, Israel, and the US through phosphate, trade, and occupation. There is a machine in the Sahara you can see from space. A conveyor belt, the longest on earth, nearly one hundred kilometers of steel from a mine called Bou Craa to the Atlantic. For half a century it has moved phosphate out of occupied Western Sahara, through wars, ceasefires, and a promised referendum that never came. The richest layer of the deposit is already gone, sold before the Sahrawis could ever vote on it. And the electricity that keeps the belt running is sold to the state by a wind farm belonging to the king. On 26 July, US President Donald Trump announced that the highway running past this machine now carries his name. The announcement arrived as a four-minute Truth Social video, narrated by an obvious AI voice praising his “historic courage.” Rabat, six days on, has not said the name out loud. It does not need to. content_en: cross-posted from: https://scribe.disroot.org/post/10175306 The partners of the Media Freedom Rapid Response (MFRR) and the Council of Europe’s Safety of Journalists Platform today present a report (opens pdf) which outlines the deteriorating situation for media freedom and safety of journalists in Serbia. The report is a result of an international mission to Belgrade that took place in March 2026. In 2025, Serbia recorded 209 press freedom violations – more than double the 84 documented in 2024 – affecting 359 media workers and entities. As of 16 June, 100 cases affecting 170 media workers have been recorded since January 2026. ... Since the deadly collapse of the Novi Sad railway station canopy in November 2024, which triggered the largest protests in Serbia’s history, attacks on journalists covering demonstrations have surged. Law enforcement has not only failed to protect journalists, but police officers have increasingly acted as perpetrators themselves, with at least 38 documented police attacks on journalists since 2025. ... The government of Serbia has been silent on one of the demands of the protest in Novi Sad regarding the publication of contracts with Chinese companies

content_en: Gold and silver — since ancient times, humanity has pursued them. Greed, bloodshed, and other instincts rise from the hearts of men — until they reach their peak at the Age of Discovery. In 1492, Columbus reached the New World. Over the next thirty years, Spaniards, Portuguese, French, and Englishmen poured into that land. They brought back gold, spices, timber and everything that could be packed into a ship's hold. But in the shadows, a pair of eyes had always been watching. When the frenzy of the New World traveled back to Europe, those eyes were no longer content with merely watching. They were ready to crawl out and orchestrate the greatest manipulation in history. 1522. Magellan survived his battle in the Philippines and was carried back to Spain by his loyal crew. He had completed the first circumnavigation. He was hailed as a hero. But in Spain, there was one man who did not agree. His name was Reyes de la Plata — known as the "Silver King," or simply "the Boss." He claimed to have been a crew member on Columbus's ship thirty years earlier. title: 代表们在百年纪念的交通停止后抓住了近40K芬太尼药丸
content: 新墨西哥州州长寻求对DEA芬太尼运输的民事损害赔偿|美联社阿尔伯克基新闻，新墨西哥州（美联社）--新墨西哥州州长周一表示，在美国缉毒局特工多次允许芬太尼流入毒品泛滥的社区，调查人员试图建立更大的案件后，该州官员可能会追究数十亿美元的民事赔偿。民主党州长米歇尔·卢扬·格里沙姆发誓要把她的愤怒“带到白宫和国会”以寻求确保DEA不再在新墨西哥州使用这种危险的执法策略--也不会在其他地方复制。新墨西哥州的过量用药激增，尽管其他州的芬太尼死亡人数有所下降。“这是联邦政府令人震惊的失败，”州长在阿尔伯克基州法医办公室举行的新闻发布会上告诉记者，加入众多州和地方执法人员和官员的行列，要求得到答案。“这是令人厌恶和卑鄙的。”DEA没有立即回应置评请求。白宫发言人阿比盖尔杰克逊指出，唐纳德特朗普总统已将芬太尼列为“大规模毁灭性武器”。

Democratic Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham vowed to take her outrage “right to the White House and Congress” to seek assurances the DEA is no longer using the risky law enforcement strategy in New Mexico — and that it is not being replicated elsewhere. title: 反对伊拉克代理人战争的长期斗争
content: 在美国和以色列对伊朗的战争不断升级的可怕局势中，沙特阿拉伯和美国于7月29日对伊拉克发动了联合无人机袭击。他们声称，袭击目标属于与伊朗结盟的人民动员部队（Quwwat al-Hashd al-Sha'bi或PMF）。虽然沙特声称他们不寻求与伊朗进一步升级，他们参与美国的打击是他们第一次公开参战。通过这次袭击，美国成功地吸引了一个主要的阿拉伯国家直接参与其侵略战争。军事力量薄弱，政治边缘化，伊拉克正在目睹一个太令人沮丧，太常见，一系列事件反映了自2003年美国入侵伊拉克以来近四分之世纪的经历。伊拉克的许多深刻和持续的危机都是由于它作为美国-以色列和伊朗之间代理人战争的竞技场的非选择角色。伊拉克近年来设法实现了一点点稳定，这要归功于它的工人和青年运动，在过去的二十年里，他们为反对外国干涉、宗派主义和买办资产阶级的腐败进行了英勇的斗争

title_en: The long struggle against proxy wars in Iraq
title_zh: 反对伊拉克代理人战争的长期斗争
content_en: By M.A. AL GHARIB In a frightening escalation of the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, Saudi Arabia and the United States on July 29 launched a joint drone attack on Iraq. The sites they targeted, they claimed, belonged to the Iran-aligned Popular Mobilization Forces ( Quwwat al-Hashd al-Sha’bi or PMF). While the Saudis claimed that they seek no further escalation with Iran, their participation in the U.S. strikes was their first open entry into the war. With this attack, the U.S. has managed to draw a major Arab state into direct participation in its war of aggression. Militarily weak and politically marginal, Iraq is witnessing an all too depressing, and all too common, set of events that echo its experience in the near quarter century since the U.S. invasion of 2003. Iraq’s many deep and ongoing crises are results from its unchosen role as an arena for proxy wars between the U.S.-Israel and Iran. That Iraq has managed to claw its way to a modicum of stability in recent years is to the credit of its workers’ and youth movements, who have waged heroic struggles over the past two decades against foreign interference, sectarianism, and the corruption of its comprador bourgeois class

content_en: By Nel Bonilla – Jul 04, 2026 How the US-led empire traded military coups and death squads for cognitive warfare, soft coups, and managed chaos. I’ve been watching two extraordinary analyses from Mexican historians and Latin American specialists—Christian Nader on Retrovisor and the panel on Contralínea’s América Insumisa—and I wanted to share some reflections on what they reveal about the evolving nature of right-wing politics in the region, and how it connects to the broader strategic logic of the US-led empire that I have been mapping under the concept of the Bunker State, the Fragmentationist Grand Strategy and the Multi-Layered Cage. The recent electoral shifts in South America—the razor-thin victories of the right in Peru, the rise of figures like Javier Milei in Argentina, the persistent strength of Bolsonarismo in Brazil—are often read as national phenomena. content: 签证取消洛佩斯·贝尔特兰引发墨西哥和华盛顿之间的争端，因为莫雷纳谴责政治干预并要求相互尊重。莫雷纳在杜兰戈的22个州取得胜利，加强运动的区域存在-签证取消López Beltrán触发莫雷纳拒签==签证取消洛佩斯·贝尔特兰案加剧了墨西哥和美国之间的政治紧张局势，此前莫雷纳拒绝了华盛顿撤销墨西哥前总统安德烈斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·贝尔特兰之子安德烈斯·曼努埃尔·洛佩斯·贝尔特兰美国签证的决定。洛佩斯·贝尔特兰此前曾担任莫雷纳的组织秘书，宣布美国取消了他的签证。他说，这一决定是出于政治动机，美国当局没有提供任何证据证明他与犯罪或其他不法行为有关。墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆称，取消签证是一种政治干预行为，她说，她不知道墨西哥对洛佩斯·贝尔特兰进行了任何刑事调查。这一争端给墨西哥和墨西哥之间本已紧张的关系增加了另一个摩擦点。

title: 核战争的风险比任何人想象的都大
content: 2026年7月30日，彼得·库兹尼克（Peter Kuznick）在长崎发表演讲。2025年6月10日，时任美国国家情报总监的塔西·加巴德（Tulsi Gabbard）在由《朝日新闻》、长崎市政府和长崎和平运动主办的国际和平会议上发表讲话。发布了一段简短但令人心酸的视频，视频以原子弹轰炸广岛的毁灭性场景开始。不过，她强调，与我们今天拥有的武器相比，在广岛和长崎使用的原子弹是原始的。她随后警告说，我们“比以往任何时候都更接近核毁灭的边缘”。可悲的是，与一年前她发表那令人不寒而栗的声明时相比，我们现在更接近核毁灭--更接近了。在她发出那次警告两天后，以色列开始轰炸伊朗。当她谴责“政治精英和战争贩子”时，是她把我们置于这样的境地。很快，美国也将加入对伊朗的攻击，徒劳地试图摧毁其核设施。但她的真实话语激怒了唐纳德去年10月20日，俄罗斯国家情报局局长谢尔盖·纳雷什金（Sergei Naryshkin）

The shadows. The first entry in this series sets the tone for what we’re going to be dealing with. If you haven’t read it yet, you can check it out here : This time, we’re going to take a look at a story told to us by a retired Belgian gendarme, Marc Toussaint. We’ll go from the dirty 80s in Brussels, in the wake of the Brabant Killers and the Haemers gang attacks, to the X witnesses investigation in the late 90s. Not everything will be covered in this part, PART III will finish the story. title: 在阿尔及利亚捣毁一个专门从事经济犯罪的国际网络
content: 奥兰当局（西北）已经拆除了一个大规模的国际有组织犯罪网络，逮捕了14名参与洗钱，税务欺诈和“可疑”资金流通的个人，阿尔及利亚警方周日报道. [阿根廷代表谴责检察官在加密骗局与哈维尔·米莱伊：在阿尔及利亚拆除一个国际网络致力于经济犯罪]（网址：根据国家安全部队的一份声明，被捕的个人创建了33家“幽灵公司”，通过这些公司，他们洗钱约7380亿阿尔及利亚第纳尔（约500万欧元）通过伪造邮票，文件和支票簿从“非法”银行账户。调查，在检察官办公室监督下，西部打击有组织犯罪区域局开展了一项行动，“追回”了29处财产，包括公寓和土地，估计价值2.6亿阿尔及利亚第纳尔（超过150万欧元）。

content_en: Authorities in Mexico’s Jalisco state seized a parcel containing 105 queen harvester ants concealed in toys on July 9. The shipment, sent from El Salto in Jalisco and destined for Laos, was falsely labeled “collectible figures,” authorities said in a press release. The parcel delivery company reported a suspicious package to Mexico’s Federal Attorney for Environmental Protection (Profepa). They found the ants. Each one stuffed in a test tube with a cotton ball, hidden inside two plastic toys; 18 of the 105 queen ants were dead, authorities said. The surviving ants were released in the Cerro Viejo Protected Natural Area in Jalisco. An ant expert determined the harvester ants belonged to the genus Pogonomyrmex, according to the release, and are native to the deserts of the Americas, including Mexico. Further investigations related to this seizure are ongoing, authorities said. Insects, including ants, have become targets for wildlife trafficking in recent years. title: 伊朗称其攻击了巴林的亚马逊基础设施
content:
据与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队有联系的官方媒体法尔斯报道，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，它已经攻击了亚马逊在巴林的数据基础设施。

法尔斯通讯社周二表示，伊斯兰革命卫队“用几枚巡航导弹袭击了美国亚马逊公司在巴林的中央数据基础设施，并将其摧毁，”根据翻译的电报帖子。

CNBC无法独立核实这一信息。CNBC已联系巴林国家通信中心和亚马逊置评。

随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布与伊朗的停火“结束”，美国和伊朗之间的敌对情绪在过去10天里不断升级。此后，双方都发动了军事打击。

在这场冲突的早期阶段，科技公司一直处于火线上。

今年3月，阿联酋的应用程序和数字服务报告称，无人机袭击了亚马逊网络服务在该国的数据中心后，该国的应用程序和数字服务中断，巴林的一个设施也遭到破坏。今年4月，IRGC威胁要袭击在中东开展业务的一系列美国科技公司，包括英伟达，苹果，微软和谷歌。

自敌对行动恢复以来，美国中央司令部连续10个晚上对伊朗进行了打击，称这些袭击是为了“降低伊朗用于攻击霍尔木兹海峡商业航运的能力”。

劳埃德分析师团队表示，自敌对行动恢复以来，通过这条关键水道的航运量有所下降，通过海峡的船只都关闭了转发器。

据贸易情报公司Kpler的数据，上周末只有30艘船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。在美国和以色列2月28日袭击伊朗之前，每天有100多艘船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。

然而，特朗普政府表示，海峡仍然开放，每天有数百万桶石油在美国军事保护下运出。

重新爆发的敌对行动使石油价格上涨。

fullText:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said it has attacked Amazon's data infrastructure in Bahrain, according to a statement reported by Fars, an IRGC-linked state media outlet.

Fars News Agency said on Tuesday the IRGC had "attacked the central data infrastructure of the American company Amazon in Bahrain with several cruise missiles and destroyed it," according to a translated Telegram post.

CNBC was unable to independently verify the information. CNBC has reached out to the National Communication Center of Bahrain and Amazon for comment.

Hostilities between the U.S. and Iran have ratcheted up over the past 10 days as President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire with Iran "over." Both sides have since launched military strikes.

Tech companies were in the line of fire throughout the earlier stages of this conflict.

In March, apps and digital services in the UAE reported outages following drone strikes on Amazon Web Services' data centers in the country, with a facility in Bahrain also damaged. In April, the IRGC threatened attacks on a swath of U.S. tech companies with operations in the Middle East, including Nvidia , Apple , Microsoft and Google .

Since hostilities have resumed, U.S. Central Command has pounded Iran with 10 straight nights of strikes, saying that the attacks are to "degrade Iranian capabilities used to attack commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz."

Shipping through the critical waterway has fallen since the resumption of hostilities, with ships transiting the strait with their transponders turned off , according to Lloyd's team of analysts.

Over the weekend, just 30 ships transited the strait, according to trade intelligence firm Kpler . More than 100 ships transited Hormuz daily before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

However, the Trump administration has said the Strait remains open and millions of barrels of oil are being shipped out daily under U.S. military protection.

The renewed hostilities have sent oil prices surging, with international benchmark Brent breaking above the $90 mark on July 20 for the first time in over a month, with U.S. crude futures also reaching their highest point in a month on the same day. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical energy chokepoint, with around 20.3 million barrels of petroleum and crude oil passing through the Strait of Hormuz daily, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration.

This accounts for roughly 25% of the world's seaborne oil trade. Nearly 90% of these oil flows are exported to Asian markets, with China and India being the primary destinations.

Amrita Sen, founder and director of market intelligence at Energy Aspects told CNBC's " Access Middle East " Monday that with inventory buffers heavily depleted, continued disruption into August could force Gulf production lower and send crude prices back into triple digits.

For its part, Iran still has the power to cause damage to U.S., its allies, and assets in the region.

Its strikes on commercial shipping have caused concern, with a vessel operated by Greek shipping firm Dynacom reportedly the latest victim. Israeli media said the ship caught fire after it was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of H…

content_zh:
据与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队有联系的官方媒体法尔斯报道，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，它已经攻击了亚马逊在巴林的数据基础设施。

法尔斯通讯社周二表示，伊斯兰革命卫队“用几枚巡航导弹袭击了美国亚马逊公司在巴林的中央数据基础设施，并将其摧毁，”根据翻译的电报帖子。

CNBC无法独立核实这一信息。CNBC已联系巴林国家通信中心和亚马逊置评。

随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布与伊朗的停火“结束”，美国和伊朗之间的敌对情绪在过去10天里不断升级。此后，双方都发动了军事打击。

在这场冲突的早期阶段，科技公司一直处于火线上。

今年3月，阿联酋的应用程序和数字服务报告称，无人机袭击了亚马逊网络服务在该国的数据中心后，该国的应用程序和数字服务中断，巴林的一个设施也遭到破坏。今年4月，IRGC威胁要袭击在中东开展业务的一系列美国科技公司，包括英伟达，苹果，微软和谷歌。

自敌对行动恢复以来，美国中央司令部连续10个晚上对伊朗进行了打击，称这些袭击是为了“降低伊朗用于攻击霍尔木兹海峡商业航运的能力”。

劳埃德分析师团队表示，自敌对行动恢复以来，通过这条关键水道的航运量有所下降，通过海峡的船只都关闭了转发器。

据贸易情报公司Kpler的数据，上周末只有30艘船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。在美国和以色列2月28日袭击伊朗之前，每天有100多艘船只通过霍尔木兹海峡。

然而，特朗普政府表示，海峡仍然开放，每天有数百万桶石油在美国军事保护下运出。

重新爆发的敌对行动使石油价格上涨。

title: 刚果民主共和国快速增长的埃博拉疫情蔓延到第六个省
content:
世卫组织负责人表示，一名男子从上韦莱旅行后在下韦莱死亡。

官员们说，刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已蔓延到第六个省。一天前，世界卫生组织负责人表示，埃博拉疫情有望超过历史上最致命的疫情，10多年前，埃博拉疫情造成至少11,000人死亡。

目前的疫情已造成4,500多例病例中的2,100多人死亡，根据周二公布的最新政府数据。根据世卫组织的数据，在2014-16年西非爆发的同一时间点，此前最致命的疫情，已记录了755例病例。

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, officials have said, a day after the head of the World Health Organization said the outbreak was on track to surpass the deadliest in history, which killed at least 11,000 people more than a decade ago.

title: 韩国城市被近一米的降雨淹没，引发致命的山体滑坡
content:
韩国南部城市巨济的一栋公寓楼发生山体滑坡，暴雨导致停电和大规模疏散

。官员们证实，自上周六以来，韩国南部地区遭受的暴雨已造成一人死亡，四人受伤。

韩国内政和安全部表示，庆尚南道（South Gyeongsang）发生了暴雨，其中包括巨济市，周末发生了800毫米（31英寸）的洪水，引发了山体滑坡。周一降雨继续，截至下午6点，累计降雨量达到912毫米。

Person dies after landslide hits apartment building in southern city of Geoje as torrential rains lead to power cuts and mass evacuations

Torrential downpours that pounded southern parts of South Korea since Saturday have killed one person and injured four others, officials have confirmed.

Heavy rains have been recorded in South Gyeongsang province, including the city of Geoje, where an 800mm (31in) deluge over the weekend triggered a landslide, the interior and safety ministry said. The rain continued on Monday, bringing the cumulative rainfall total to 912mm by 6pm.

title: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉病毒：有记录以来最致命的爆发“超过了反应”
content: Eve Irvine很高兴欢迎世卫组织发言人Tarik Jašarević。他的主要关切是，我们还不知道埃博拉病毒传播的所有地方：受感染的人仍然在治疗中心之外，传播链没有被发现，太晚寻求治疗的病人生存机会要小得多。冲突、人口流动和其他人道主义压力使监测更加困难，但社区参与同样至关重要。没有信任与合作，检测、接触者追踪、安全埋葬和早期治疗就无法有效发挥作用。

title_en: Ebola in DRC: Deadliest outbreak on record ‘outpacing the response’
title_zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉病毒：有记录以来最致命的爆发“超过了反应”
content_en: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome WHO Spokesperson Tarik Jašarević. His central concern is that we do not yet know where all the places the Ebola virus is circulating: infected people remain outside treatment centres, transmission chains go undetected, and patients who seek care too late face much poorer chances of survival. Conflict, population mobility and other humanitarian pressures make surveillance more difficult, but community engagement is equally crucial. Without trust and cooperation, testing, contact tracing, safe burials and early treatment cannot work effectively.

title: 委内瑞拉地震的新殖民主义报道增加了伤害
content: 6月24日，委内瑞拉发生了毁灭性的双重地震，造成了大量破坏和数千人死亡。在南美洲国家受灾最严重的沿海拉瓜伊拉州，数十座建筑物倒塌。这场自然灾害是在两次非自然灾害之后发生的：美国领导的长达十多年的经济制裁，以及1月3日美国的爆炸袭击和总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的绑架。但与其同情这个陷入困境的国家，西方媒体机构抓住机会继续妖魔化玻利瓦尔革命--同时粉饰华盛顿的经济恐怖主义及其目前加紧对该国半殖民地控制的努力（FAIR.org，2026年2月27日）。对公共住房的攻击-“这些房子是委内瑞拉社会主义革命的产物，现在它们成了瓦砾。”一位建筑师被引述说，这些受损的公寓是“匆忙建造的”，以“迎接政治死亡”。

The natural disaster followed two unnatural catastrophes: a decade-plus of US-led economic sanctions, and the January 3 US bombing attack and kidnapping of President Nicolás Maduro. title: 伊朗改变了问题，华盛顿没有答案
content: 30多年来，美国一直把中东外交视为替他国制定条款的活动。伊朗正在形成的地区战略正在挑战这种特权。霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）就是最直接的证据。伊朗和阿曼正在就一项安排进行谈判，根据这项安排，德黑兰可以监督进入海湾的船只，而麝香则负责管理出境交通。这项提议仍未敲定，但它所代表的东西比海事协议更大：伊朗正试图将外交议程从其核合规的狭隘问题转向更广泛的海湾安全架构。自冷战结束以来，美国在中东的外交往往以这样一个结论开始：华盛顿界定危机，确定可接受的各方，并确定了最终解决方案的边界。谈判因此不再是对政治秩序的讨论，而是要求弱国接受政治秩序的过程。这一制度并不是真正意义上的投降文件，但它们经常带有投降的政治逻辑：一方保留决定什么算投降的权力。

content_en: For more than three decades, the United States has treated Middle Eastern diplomacy as an exercise in writing the terms for others. Iran’s emerging regional strategy is challenging that privilege. The immediate evidence is emerging in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran and Oman are negotiating an arrangement under which Tehran could oversee vessels entering the Gulf while Muscat manages outbound traffic. The proposal remains unsettled, but it represents something larger than a maritime agreement: Iran is attempting to move the diplomatic agenda away from the narrow question of its nuclear compliance and towards the wider architecture of Gulf security. Since the end of the Cold War, US diplomacy in the Middle East has often begun with a conclusion: Washington defines the crisis, identifies the acceptable parties, and sets the boundaries of the eventual settlement. Negotiation then becomes less a discussion over the political order than a process through which weaker states are asked to accept it. title: 肯尼亚一座拟议中的核电站遭到强烈反对

content_en: Opposition to Kenya’s proposed nuclear power plant in Siaya County has intensified after community activists and residents protesting the project were arrested and investigated under terrorism-related allegations, prompting accusations of state repression from civil society organizations and progressive groups. The controversy centers on the government’s plan to construct what officials describe as Kenya’s first commercial nuclear power plant in Central Sakwa, Siaya County, on the shores of Lake Victoria. title: 委内瑞拉启动气候预防计划电网面临挑战
content: 周日，委内瑞拉代总统德尔西·罗德里格斯（Delcy Rodríguez）与该国州长和内阁成员举行了视频会议，审查6月24日地震后恢复国家电力系统（SEN）的进展情况，并下令立即启动预防措施，以应对有关被称为“超级厄尔尼诺”的气候现象的预测。罗德里格斯报告说，受地震影响的地区的电力服务正在逐步恢复，并警告说，委内瑞拉在未来几个月内将面临严重的高温和干旱。罗德里格斯解释说，地震造成输电线路严重损坏，国家电力系统的热电发电基础设施。她强调了电力部门工作人员为稳定该系统所做的努力。“在拉瓜伊拉州，我们在一周内实现了创纪录的服务恢复。然而，我们也对沿着Planta Centro-Yaracuy线的电塔造成了破坏。最严重的破坏发生在Termo卡拉博博热电厂，这为国家电力系统提供了600兆瓦的电力，”她说。

content_en: On Sunday, Venezuelan Acting President Delcy Rodríguez held a videoconference with the country’s governors and cabinet members to review progress in restoring the National Electric System (SEN) following the June 24 earthquakes and to order the immediate activation of preventive measures in response to forecasts concerning the climate phenomenon known as “Super Niño.” During her address, Rodríguez reported that electricity service is being progressively restored in areas affected by the earthquake and warned about the severity of the high temperatures and droughts forecast for Venezuela in the upcoming months. title: 波兰和波罗的海国家在担心俄罗斯使用乌克兰无人机进行假旗攻击的情况下加强安全
content: 据路透社https://scribe.disroot.org/post/10649589报道，立陶宛上周表示，莫斯科正在考虑这样一次分期袭击，波兰、拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚也警告说，在美国对西方军事联盟的承诺受到质疑之际，北约的反应将受到破坏。“我们并不天真，我们看到了信息，我们从字里行间读到了信息，我们正在做功课，“立陶宛国防部长罗伯塔斯考纳斯告诉路透社。“我们正在增加我们关键基础设施的安全，我们不断与我们的情报交换下一步该怎么做的信息。”上个月，立陶宛部署部队增援负责保护一个液化天然气进口码头，一个石油产品码头，与波兰的一条关键输电线路，以及克鲁奥尼斯抽水蓄能水电站。.拉脱维亚总理安德里斯·库尔伯格斯（Andris Kulbergs）告诉路透社，拉脱维亚还加强了全国关键基础设施周围的安全，包括里加附近道加瓦河（Daugava River）上的一座大坝和因丘卡尔斯（Inčukalns）地下天然气储存设施。“潜在的混合威胁比以前更有可能，”他说。

title_zh: 在科隆博，亚洲重新定义主权
content_en: Four years ago, Colombo was the world’s cautionary tale. A sovereign default, fuel queues that stretched for kilometers, a presidential palace occupied by its own citizens. Over the last week, the same city is hosting trade unionists, party cadre, scholars, and ministers from across Asia, from Nepal to the Philippines and from Iran to Indonesia. They have gathered under a banner that would have sounded utopian in 2022: Hands Off Asia. The choice of venue is the argument. Sri Lanka’s crisis was never only Sri Lankan. It was the compressed experience of what much of Asia lives in slow motion: production structures designed under colonialism to serve the core, debt that disciplines every budget, and an international order that punishes any attempt to exit. The three-day assembly, convened by the International Peoples’ Assembly and Tricontinental: Institute for Social Research, opened on July 16 with a plenary that set out its central claim. Sovereignty in the twenty-first century is not a flag and a seat at the United Nations. It is an integrated condition spanning finance, technology, data, and defense. title: 对数据中心的反对继续增加
content: 赫尔曼莫里斯：在全国范围内，反对新数据中心的运动继续增长。每天，在街道上和市政霍尔斯，人们都在反对他们的建设。7月18日，在42个州发生了142起反对数据中心的抗议活动，其中大多数在德克萨斯州。人们提到的问题通常是高昂的电费、用水、排放以及光和噪音污染。除此之外，尽管如此，反数据中心的抗议活动--以及反对弗洛克监控摄像头扩散的联合抗议活动--揭示了一场新的群众运动的开始，这场运动要求对城镇及其周围的资源进行民主控制，以反对科技亿万富翁接管经济。这场新的群众运动还表明，有可能打破工人阶级之间通常存在的党派分歧。阶级社区，共和党和民主党选民在很大程度上相互对立。这场大规模的抗议活动使两党的资本主义政客陷入危机，纽约和德克萨斯州都不得不宣布暂停数据中心，以减少愤怒。反对数据中心的抗议活动，这些抗议活动给资本主义政客带来的压力，

title_en: Opposition to data centers continues to mount
title_zh: 对数据中心的反对继续增加
content_en: By HERMAN MORRIS Across the country, the movement against new data centers continues to grow. Every day, in the streets and in town halls, people are speaking out against their construction. July 18 saw 142 protests in 42 states opposing data centers, with most being in Texas. The concerns cited are often high electricity costs, water usage, emissions, and light and noise pollution. Looking beyond that, though, the anti-data center protests—and allied protests against the proliferation of Flock surveillance cameras—reveal the opening of a new mass movement demanding democratic control of towns and resources around them in opposition to a tech-billionaire takeover of the economy. This new mass movement has also demonstrated the potential to cut through usual partisan divides among working-class communities with Republican and Democratic voters largely in opposition to one another. This mass protest has thrown capitalist politicians on both sides of the aisle into a crisis, with New York and Texas both having to announce data center moratoriums to curtail outrage. content: In a move that is as farcical as it is shameful, Irish immigration authorities have refused large numbers of study visas for students from Gaza seeking to enrol at universities. RTÉ say that: …upwards of 20 Gazan students, who have all been accepted onto fully funded scholarships for third-level courses, have had their visa applications turned down by Irish immigration authorities. Others are awaiting outcomes. The farce lies in the nature of the refusal letters, which read like a sort of cruel joke. RTÉ reports the reasons given for refusing applications to study include: …not supplying original bank statements, a failure to account for gaps in their education, and a failure to supply strong evidence that they will return home once their course of study is completed. Gaza students face inhumane rejection letters --------------------------------------------- Many of us have trouble digging out old bank statements from wherever we left them several months ago. content_en: By Teri Mattson – Jul 18, 2026 After Venezuela’s twin earthquakes, world attention focused on casualty counts and political arguments. But another story was unfolding beneath the headlines. Every few minutes, an entire city fell silent. Excavators stopped digging. Ambulances shut off their engines. Police halted traffic. Rescue workers raised their hands, signaling everyone to stop moving, stop talking, stop making noise. Then they listened. Somewhere beneath thousands of tons of shattered concrete, someone might still be alive. For two or three minutes at a time, silence became the most important tool in Venezuela’s rescue effort. title: RT报道了美国撤离五年后阿富汗的新现实
content:
阿富汗庆祝塔利班在美国混乱的撤军中重新掌权五周年。全国各地举行了庆祝活动，官员们称阿富汗更安全，更自由。

2001年底，美国在9·11恐怖袭击后入侵阿富汗。华盛顿认定基地组织应对此次袭击负责。该组织的领导人，包括奥萨马·本·拉登，当时就驻扎在塔利班控制的阿富汗。

2021年8月，随着西方支持的阿富汗政府迅速垮台，塔利班重新夺回喀布尔，美国军队撤出了阿富汗。阿富汗曾是美国外交政策的核心--美国纳税人为20年的占领支付了约2.3万亿美元的费用--此后，阿富汗基本上淡出了西方的视线。

然而，阿富汗仍然受到广泛的制裁，而塔利班政府在国外仍然基本上不被承认。

RT印度的Runjhun Sharma前往阿富汗，看看这个国家发生了多大的变化，以及它现在是否像当局声称的那样安全，并指出“塔利班的故事有很多细微差别，很多层次。”

excerpt: Five years after the US withdrawal, Afghanistan is safer but still grappling with sanctions and diplomatic isolation, RT reports Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
Afghanistan has marked five years since the Taliban swept back to power amid a chaotic US withdrawal. Celebrations have been held across the country, with officials describing Afghanistan as safer and "free."

The US invaded Afghanistan in late 2001 following the September 11 attacks, for which Washington identified Al-Qaeda as being responsible. The group's leaders, including Osama bin Laden, were based in Taliban-controlled Afghanistan at the time.

US forces withdrew as the country's Western-backed government rapidly collapsed and the Taliban recaptured Kabul in August 2021. Once central to US foreign policy – with American taxpayers footing an estimated $2.3 trillion bill for the 20-year occupation – Afghanistan has since largely faded from Western attention.

However, Afghanistan remains under sweeping sanctions, while the Taliban government is still largely unrecognized abroad.

RT India's Runjhun Sharma traveled to Afghanistan to see how much the country has changed – and whether it is now as safe as its authorities claim, noting "there's a lot of nuance, a lot of layers to the Taliban story."

Watch her report below, part of RT India's upcoming series on Afghanistan.

title: 尽管霍尔木兹中断，“黑暗”石油贸易仍在流动-彭博社
content:
2026年6月21日，商业货船和原油油轮停泊在阿曼麝香海岸外的阿曼湾。彭博社周日援引知情人士的话报道称，尽管正常交通受到严重干扰，袭击时断时续，海湾国家仍在通过油轮秘密运输石油，油轮的转发器被关闭。

知情人士在不愿透露姓名的情况下告诉彭博社，通过这条严重中断的通道运输的原油量超过了市场估计的每天400万桶，但没有具体说明具体数量。据报道，阿联酋、伊拉克、卡塔尔和科威特一直在使用“黑暗”油轮运输通过霍尔木兹海峡运输原油，随后原油被转移到阿曼湾的其他船只上。

风险仍然很大，ADNOC告诉彭博社，自美伊冲突开始以来，其23艘船只遭到袭击，造成一名船员死亡，20人受伤。上周，ADNOC报告称，其两艘船只在霍尔木兹遭到袭击，所有船员报告安全。阿联酋当局指责伊朗发动袭击，呼吁德黑兰重新开放海峡。

沙特阿拉伯似乎也准备使用这条航线，有16艘超级油轮位于阿曼海岸外，预计未来几天还会有3艘，并补充说这些船只可以运载多达3800万桶石油。

保险公司表示，尽管存在危险，但他们看到海湾生产商不断提出投保要求。“这是一笔黑暗的交易，”Heidmar Maritime Holdings首席执行官Pankaj卡纳对彭博社（Bloomberg）表示，他将其描述为唯一的选择，尽管许多船东仍不愿承担风险。

excerpt: Gulf producers are reportedly moving crude through the Strait of Hormuz on tankers with transponders off Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
A view of commercial cargo vessels and crude oil tankers are anchored in the Gulf of Oman, off the coast of Muscat, Oman, June 21, 2026. Gulf states are covertly shipping oil through the Strait of Hormuz on tankers with their transponders switched off despite severe disruptions to normal traffic and intermittent attacks, Bloomberg reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the shipments.

The volumes shipped through the heavily disrupted passage exceed market estimates of 4 million barrels per day, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg on condition of anonymity, without specifying by how much. The UAE, Iraq, Qatar, and Kuwait have reportedly been moving barrels through Hormuz using "dark" tanker transits, with crude later transferred to other vessels in the Gulf of Oman.

The risks remain significant, with ADNOC telling Bloomberg that 23 of its vessels have come under attack since the US-Iran conflict began, leaving one crew member dead and 20 others injured. Last week, ADNOC reported that two of its vessels came under attack in Hormuz, with all crew members reported safe. UAE authorities blamed Iran for the attacks, calling on Tehran to reopen the strait.

Saudi Arabia also appears to be preparing to use the route, with 16 supertankers positioned off Oman's coast and three more expected in the coming days, the news agency noted, adding that the vessels can carry up to 38 million barrels of oil.

Insurers say they are seeing a steady stream of requests for coverage from Gulf producers despite the dangers. "It's a dark trade," Pankaj Khanna, CEO of Heidmar Maritime Holdings, told Bloomberg, describing it as the only option even as many shipowners remain unwilling to take the risk.

title: 基辅打北约的战争“直到最后一个乌克兰人”-美国记者（视频）
content:
美国记者兼地缘政治分析师约翰？瓦罗利（John Varoli）说，基辅政权正在以牺牲本国人民的利益为代价，对俄罗斯发动北约代理人战争，而其领导层则将西方的资金收入囊中。

瓦罗利周五在接受RT采访时表示，乌克兰的弗拉基米尔泽伦斯基和“他的派系”对乌克兰人民“绝对没有兴趣”，并补充说他们既不代表，也不关心，也不为他们服务。

瓦罗利说：“乌克兰政权符合北约国家的利益，这些国家正在对俄罗斯发动代理人战争。他们真的愿意战斗到最后一个乌克兰人。”

瓦罗利说，泽伦斯基在布鲁塞尔、华盛顿和伦敦的“主人”正在告诉基辅，要尽可能长时间地与俄罗斯作战。

这名记者声称，基辅拒绝接受阵亡乌克兰士兵的尸体，因为它必须赔偿他们的家人。他补充说，基辅政权拥有“巨额资金”，每月从北约获得数十亿美元。

“但问题是，这些钱去了哪里？”瓦罗利说，并补充说：“这些钱进了泽连斯基和他的寡头们的口袋。这些钱被偷了。”

excerpt: Kiev serves the interests of NATO countries “fighting a proxy war against Russia,” US journalist John Varoli has told RT Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
© Getty Images / Anadolu / Contributor The Kiev regime is fighting a NATO proxy war against Russia at the expense of its own people, while its leadership pockets Western funding, US journalist and geopolitical analyst John Varoli said.

Speaking to RT on Friday, Varoli said Ukraine's Vladimir Zelensky and "his clique" have "absolutely no interest" in the Ukrainian people, adding that they neither represent, care for, nor serve them.

"The Ukrainian regime serves the interests of the NATO countries, which are fighting a proxy war against Russia," Varoli said. "They are literally willing to fight until the last Ukrainian," he added.

Varoli said Zelensky's "masters" in Brussels, Washington, DC, and London are telling Kiev to keep fighting Russia for as long as they can.

Kiev is refusing to accept the bodies of fallen Ukrainian soldiers because it would have to compensate their families, the journalist claimed, adding that the regime has "huge amounts of money" and receives billions of dollars from NATO every month.

"But the question is, where is that money going?" Varoli said, adding: "It's going into the pockets of Zelensky and his oligarchs. That money is being stolen."

title: 美国指责中国关税“骗局”盟友
content:
白宫指责40多个国家，包括一些最亲密的合作伙伴，通过利用对第三国征税的差异来帮助中国商品逃避美国关税。

白宫周四发布了一份长达25页的新报告，题为《大转运骗局》，其中提到了加拿大、墨西哥、日本、韩国、印度、以色列、台湾和欧盟。

该文件声称，“骗局”涉及将中国制造的商品通过另一个国家发送，在那里它们被轻度加工，重新包装或重新贴上标签，然后以新的申报原产地运往美国。

华盛顿表示，这种做法是在唐纳德·特朗普总统于2018年对中国产品征收全面关税后开始的。自重返办公室以来，特朗普已将征税范围扩大到世界大部分地区，造成贸易伙伴之间关税率的巨大差异。上个月，他还对来自60个国家的进口产品征收新的关税，原因是据称未能打击强迫劳动，这引起了美国几个主要伙伴的抗议。白宫承认，这种差距本身可能会增加改道的动机。

中国一再谴责特朗普的关税制度，指责华盛顿的保护主义和经济胁迫，并认为其贸易和技术限制扰乱了全球商业。

excerpt: The White House has accused dozens of US partners of helping Chinese goods avoid American tariffs through third-country trade routes Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
FILE PHOTO. © Getty Images / shaunl The White House has accused more than 40 nations, including some of its closest partners, of helping Chinese goods evade US tariffs by exploiting differences in levies imposed on third countries.

A new 25-page report titled 'The Great Transshipment Scam', released by the White House on Thursday, names Canada, Mexico, Japan, South Korea, India, Israel, Taiwan, and the EU among those allegedly involved in the practice.

The document claims the "scam" involves sending Chinese-made goods through another country, where they are lightly processed, repackaged, or relabeled before being shipped to the US under a new declared origin.

Washington says the practice took off after President Donald Trump imposed sweeping tariffs on Chinese products in 2018. Since returning to office, Trump has expanded levies to much of the world, creating wide differences in tariff rates between trading partners. Last month, he also imposed new tariffs on imports from 60 countries over alleged failures to combat forced labor, drawing protests from several major US partners. The White House acknowledged that such gaps may themselves have increase incentives for rerouting.

China has repeatedly condemned Trump's tariff regime, accusing Washington of protectionism and economic coercion and arguing that its trade and technology restrictions disrupt global commerce.

白宫指责40多个国家，包括一些最亲密的合作伙伴，通过利用对第三国征税的差异来帮助中国商品逃避美国关税。

白宫周四发布了一份长达25页的新报告，题为《大转运骗局》，其中提到了加拿大、墨西哥、日本、韩国、印度、以色列、台湾和欧盟。

该文件声称，“骗局”涉及将中国制造的商品通过另一个国家发送，在那里它们被轻度加工，重新包装或重新贴上标签，然后以新的申报原产地运往美国。

华盛顿表示，这种做法是在唐纳德·特朗普总统于2018年对中国产品征收全面关税后开始的。自重返办公室以来，特朗普已将征税范围扩大到世界大部分地区，造成贸易伙伴之间关税率的巨大差异。上个月，他还对来自60个国家的进口产品征收新的关税，原因是据称未能打击强迫劳动，这引起了美国几个主要伙伴的抗议。白宫承认，这种差距本身可能会增加改道的动机。

中国一再谴责特朗普的关税制度，指责华盛顿的保护主义和经济胁迫，并认为其贸易和技术限制扰乱了全球商业。

title: 美国在伊朗战争中失去了四分之一的收割者无人机- WaPo
content:
一架MQ-9“收割者”无人机在内华达州克里奇空军基地执行训练使命时飞过，2015年11月17日© Getty Images ; Isaac Brekken据《华盛顿邮报》报道，在对伊朗的战争中，美国军方损失了45架MQ-9“收割者”无人机，占其全部侦察机供应的四分之一。这一损失给美国纳税人造成了约13亿美元的损失。

华盛顿邮报星期四援引三名未透露姓名的美国官员的话透露了损失数字。第四名美国官员告诉该报，并非所有丢失的无人机都被击落。他们说，有些无人机是在与操作员失去联系后坠毁的。

MQ-9 Reaper于2007年开始在美国空军服役，并在伊拉克、阿富汗以及美国在巴基斯坦、索马里、也门等地的不宣而战的战争中广泛使用。MQ-9 Reaper是巴拉克·奥巴马总统的无人机暗杀计划的代名词，直到2017年也门胡塞武装成功，MQ-9 Reaper才被视为不可触碰的

excerpt: The US military has lost a quarter of its pre-war stock of MQ-9 Reaper drones while fighting Iran, the Washington Post has reported Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
An MQ-9 Reaper dreone flies by during a training mission at Creech Air Force Base, Nevada, November 17, 2015 © Getty Images ; Isaac Brekken The US military lost 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones, or a quarter of its entire supply of the reconnaissance craft, during its war on Iran, the Washington Post has reported. The loss cost the US taxpayer an estimated $1.3 billion.

The loss figures were revealed by the Washington Post on Thursday, citing three unnamed US officials. A fourth US official told the newspaper that not all the lost drones were shot down. Some, they said, crashed after losing communications with their operators.

A successor to the MQ-1 Predator, the MQ-9 Reaper is a medium-altitude long-endurance (MALE) drone, capable of flying for up to 30 hours while carrying out surveillance missions or targeted strikes with Hellfire missiles. One of these craft costs between $30 and $50 million, and the US military had approximately 185 before the US-Israeli war on Iran began on February 28 – 165 in the Air Force, and 20 operated by the Marine Corps.

Within hours of the war beginning, reports of downed Reapers began circulating on Iranian Telegram channels. Video footage soon followed, with the Iranian military claiming to have shot down multiple MQ-9s mid-flight, and destroyed others as they sat in hangars at US bases across the Gulf region.

By the time the US and Iran reached a tentative ceasefire on April 9, preliminary reports in US media suggested that around two dozen Reapers had been shot down by Iranian forces. If the Washington Post's figures are accurate, the initial accounts may have undercounted the losses by almost half.

The MQ-9 Reaper entered service with the US Air Force in 2007, and was extensively used in Iraq, Afghanistan, and in the US' undeclared wars in Pakistan, Somalia, Yemen, and beyond. Synonymous with President Barack Obama's drone assassination program, the MQ-9 Reaper was viewed as untouchable until 2017, when Houthi forces in Yemen managed to shoot one down with a Soviet-era anti-air missile.

A string of losses followed, and by the time the US and Israel began striking Iran in February, the Reaper was already considered obsolete and ineffective against any military with anti-air capabilities.

The Reaper is one of multiple weapons systems left in short supply by the Iran war. The US has reportedly used more than half of its Patriot and 80% of its THAAD anti-air missiles, and a third of its Tomahawk cruise missiles since February 28. US President Donald Trump has denied that the US is facing a missile shortage, but has asked Congress for $87.6 billion to cover "urgent needs" related to the war, including $21 billion for munitions.

title: Zelensky的导弹数学错误：这就是为什么他的数字远远不够
content:
泽伦斯基在接受美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）采访时表示，乌克兰目前拥有足够的爱国者拦截器，相当于美国现有库存的约1%-据报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和他的战争部长皮特·赫格塞斯之间的一些尖刻言论已经耗尽。

尽管如此，泽伦斯基还是利用CNN的采访呼吁华盛顿向乌克兰出售剩余爱国者导弹库存的5%，他声称这足以让基辅度过冬天。这位前演员在电视上更进一步，他说美国10%的库存将使乌克兰能够击落向该国发射的每一枚俄罗斯弹道导弹。

但这些数字很快就开始在仔细审查下分崩离析。

美国有多少导弹，泽连斯基想要什么？

美国目前掌握的爱国者拦截器总数是保密的，但最近的估计数字约为800个，据报道，美国在伊朗战争期间烧毁了其总库存的65%。

因此，泽连斯基提出的10%的转让将相当于大约80架爱国者拦截机。

据报道，7月5日至6日，俄罗斯发射了29枚弹道导弹或类似的高速导弹，攻击重点是基辅。乌克兰没有拦截到任何导弹，乌克兰官员将失败归咎于缺乏拦截器。

即使假设每枚爱国者拦截器都能摧毁一枚来袭弹道导弹，80枚拦截器也只能摧毁80个目标。按照泽连斯基自己所说的每次大规模攻击30-40枚弹道导弹的速度，这将为大约两次大规模攻击提供足够的弹药--同样是假设每枚拦截器都能击中目标。

每个月有三到五次这样的攻击，每次攻击涉及30到40枚弹道导弹，相当于每个月大约有90到200枚弹道导弹来袭。80枚爱国者拦截器不可能100%成功地摧毁所有这些导弹。
