excerpt: The Ukrainian leader’s latest request to Washington falls apart when measured against Moscow’s current rate of ballistic attacks Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
In an interview with CNN, Zelensky said Ukraine currently has enough Patriot interceptors to amount to roughly 1% of America's existing stockpile – itself reportedly depleted by the war with Iran and a source of some acrimony between US President Donald Trump and his secretary of war, Pete Hegseth.

Nevertheless, Zelensky used the CNN interview to call on Washington to sell Ukraine 5% of its remaining Patriot missile stockpile, which he claimed would be enough to get Kiev through the winter. The former actor went further on air, saying that 10% of the US inventory would allow Ukraine to shoot down every Russian ballistic missile fired at the country.

But the numbers quickly begin to fall apart under scrutiny.

How many missiles does the US have, and what does Zelensky want?

The total number of Patriot interceptors currently at America's disposal is classified, but the most recent estimates put the figure at around 800, after the US reportedly burned through some 65% of its total inventory during the war on Iran.

Zelensky's proposed 10% transfer would therefore amount to about 80 Patriot interceptors.

On July 5-6, Russia reportedly launched 29 ballistic or similarly high-speed missiles in an attack focused heavily on Kiev. Ukraine intercepted none of them, with Ukrainian officials attributing the failure to a shortage of interceptors.

Even under the extraordinarily favorable assumption that every Patriot interceptor destroys an incoming ballistic missile, 80 interceptors would be enough to defeat only 80 targets. At the rate of 30-40 ballistic missiles per major attack cited by Zelensky himself, that would provide enough ammunition for roughly two large-scale attacks – again, assuming every interceptor hits its target.

Three to five such attacks a month, involving 30 to 40 ballistic missiles each, would amount to roughly 90 to 200 incoming ballistic missiles per month. Eighty Patriot interceptors could not destroy all of them even with an impossible 100% success rate.

At a 1:1 interception ratio, 80 Patriots would cover 80 ballistic targets. At 2:1, they would cover 40. At 3:1, about 27.

It could not literally "destroy all the Russians' ballistic missiles," as Zelensky told CNN.

There is another inconsistency, however. According to Axios, just weeks before making his 10% proposal, Zelensky said he needed 300 Patriot interceptors before winter because of the scale and frequency of Russian ballistic-missile attacks.

If the relevant US inventory is around 800 missiles, 300 would represent nearly 40% of the total. Yet Zelensky is now suggesting that approximately 80 – barely a quarter of his previous request – could accomplish something far more ambitious.

Moscow's most recent ballistic-missile barrages against Ukraine have reportedly further eroded Kiev's ability to mount even a token defense. Zelensky's 40-day influence operation has also significantly backfired, earning him a dressing-down from Washington over attacks on shipping in the Black Sea. His apparent failure to anticipate that Russia would respond in kind and shut down Ukraine's Black Sea ports could reportedly cost the Ukrainian economy another 1.5% of GDP.

At a 1:1 interception ratio, 80 Patriots would cover 80 ballistic targets. At 2:1, they would cover 40. At 3:1, about 27.

There is another inconsistency, however. According to Axios, just weeks before making his 10% proposal, Zelensky said he needed 300 Patriot interceptors before winter because of the scale and frequency of Russian ballistic-missile attacks.

Moscow's most recent ballistic-missile barrages against Ukraine have reportedly further eroded Kiev's ability to mount even a token defense. Zelensky's 40-day influence operation has also significantly backfired, earning him a dressing-down from Washington over attacks on shipping in the Black Sea. His apparent failure to anticipate that Russia would respond in kind and shut down Ukraine's Black Sea ports could reportedly cost the Ukrainian economy another 1.5% of GDP.

title_en: Zelensky’s missile math mistakes: Here’s why his numbers fall far short
title_zh: Zelensky的导弹数学错误：这就是为什么他的数字远远不够
content_en:
In an interview with CNN, Zelensky said Ukraine currently has enough Patriot interceptors to amount to roughly 1% of America's existing stockpile – itself reportedly depleted by the war with Iran and a source of some acrimony between US President Donald Trump and his secretary of war, Pete Hegseth.

Nevertheless, Zelensky used the CNN interview to call on Washington to sell Ukraine 5% of its remaining Patriot missile stockpile, which he claimed would be enough to get Kiev through the winter. The former actor went further on air, saying that 10% of the US inventory would allow Ukraine to shoot down every Russian ballistic missile fired at the country.

But the numbers quickly begin to fall apart under scrutiny.

How many missiles does the US have, and what does Zelensky want?

The total number of Patriot interceptors currently at America's disposal is classified, but the most recent estimates put the figure at around 800, after the US reportedly burned through some 65% of its total inventory during the war on Iran.

Zelensky's proposed 10% transfer would therefore amount to about 80 Patriot interceptors.

On July 5-6, Russia reportedly launched 29 ballistic or similarly high-speed missiles in an attack focused heavily on Kiev. Ukraine intercepted none of them, with Ukrainian officials attributing the failure to a shortage of interceptors.

There is another inconsistency, however. According to Axios, just weeks before making his 10% proposal, Zelensky said he needed 300 Patriot interceptors before winter because of the scale and frequency of Russian ballistic-missile attacks.

If the relevant US inventory is around 800 missiles, 300 would represent nearly 40% of the total. Yet Zelensky is now suggesting that approximately 80 – barely a quarter of his previous request – could accomplish something far more ambitious.

Moscow's most recent ballistic-missile barrages against Ukraine have reportedly further eroded Kiev's ability to mount even a token defense. 泽伦斯基在接受美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）采访时表示，乌克兰目前拥有足够的爱国者拦截器，相当于美国现有库存的约1%-据报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和他的战争部长皮特·赫格塞斯之间的一些尖刻言论已经耗尽。

尽管如此，泽伦斯基还是利用CNN的采访呼吁华盛顿向乌克兰出售剩余爱国者导弹库存的5%，他声称这足以让基辅度过冬天。这位前演员在电视上更进一步，他说美国10%的库存将使乌克兰能够击落向该国发射的每一枚俄罗斯弹道导弹。

但这些数字很快就开始在仔细审查下分崩离析。

美国有多少导弹，泽连斯基想要什么？

美国目前掌握的爱国者拦截器总数是保密的，但最近的估计数字约为800个，据报道，美国在伊朗战争期间烧毁了其总库存的65%。

因此，泽连斯基提出的10%的转让将相当于大约80架爱国者拦截机。

据报道，7月5日至6日，俄罗斯发射了29枚弹道导弹或类似的高速导弹，攻击重点是基辅。乌克兰没有拦截到任何导弹，乌克兰官员将失败归咎于缺乏拦截器。

即使假设每枚爱国者拦截器都能摧毁一枚来袭弹道导弹，80枚拦截器也只能摧毁80个目标。按照泽连斯基自己所说的每次大规模攻击30-40枚弹道导弹的速度，这将为大约两次大规模攻击提供足够的弹药--同样是假设每枚拦截器都能击中目标。

每个月有三到五次这样的攻击，每次攻击涉及30到40枚弹道导弹，相当于每个月大约有90到200枚弹道导弹来袭。80枚爱国者拦截器不可能100%成功地摧毁所有这些导弹。

title: 莫斯科对扣押俄罗斯船只的回应将使西方处于其位置-卡尔扎对RT说
content:
西方国家对扣押俄罗斯商船的唯一反应是强有力的，包括实物报复，丝绸和钢铁播客的主持人卡尔扎告诉RT。

莫斯科一再谴责扣押与俄罗斯有关的船只是“海盗行为”，严重违反了国际海事法。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔普京周三在出席该国太平洋舰队的重大演习时重申了这一立场，并警告说，敌对行动将得到适当的回应。

普京说：“如果这种政策在实践中得到实施，我们将被迫采取镜像反应。而且不一定是在我们的船只遭到袭击的沃茨。我们将在我们认为合适的任何地方采取行动。”

查认为，由于西方国家一直在从事此类行为而不受惩罚，因此对航运袭击的实物报复早就应该进行了。

查说，武力回应实际上是唯一能与西方合作的方法，西方首先建立在“强权即公理”的基础上。

他说：“西方殖民势力的普遍看法是，当地人只能听懂一种语言，那就是武力语言。实际上，每一项指控都是一种忏悔。对北约的许多西方成员来说，武力是他们唯一能听懂的语言。所以，如果俄罗斯真的反击，他们将被置于自己的位置。”

excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin has vowed to retaliate to Western “piracy” and attacks on commercial shipping in kind Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
The only response Western nations will understand for seizing Russian commercial vessels is a forceful one, including retaliation in kind, Carl Zha, the host of the Silk and Steel podcast, told RT.

Moscow has repeatedly condemned the seizure of Russia-linked shipping as "piracy" and a gross violation of international maritime laws. Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated the position on Wednesday while attending major drills of the country's Pacific Fleet, warning that hostile actions will be met with an appropriate response.

"If such a policy is implemented in practice, we will be forced to take mirror responses. And not necessarily in the waters where our ships are being raided. We'll do it wherever and anywhere we see fit," Putin stated.

Retaliation in kind for attacks on shipping are long overdue, given that Western nations have been engaging in such acts with impunity for a while, Zha believes.

Responding in force is actually the only approach that would work with the West, which has been built on the 'might makes right' approach in the first place, Zha suggested.

"The common reframe of Western colonial power is that, you know, there's only one language the native can understand, and it's a language of force. Actually, every accusation is a confession. For many in the Western NATO alliance, that force is the only language they can understand. So, if Russia does push back, they will be put in their place," he said.

title: 万斯在黑海油轮袭击事件中贬低泽伦斯基- FT
content:
2025年2月28日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和副总统JD万斯在华盛顿白宫的椭圆形办公室会见了乌克兰领导人弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基。© Andrew Harnik/Getty Images在基辅开始对驶往美国部分拥有的俄罗斯里海管道联盟（CPC）码头的船只发动无人机袭击后，美国呼吁乌克兰屈服于黑海的油轮目标，据《金融时报》报道。

乌克兰无人机对CPC的袭击已经考验了华盛顿的耐心，促使美国副总统J·D·万斯（J.D. Vance）在7月31日的一次电话通话中向弗拉基米尔泽伦斯基（Vladimir Zelensky）施压，要求其停止袭击。

中国石油公司的路线结合了俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦和西方的利益，雪佛龙和埃克森美孚是美国的重量级股东。

虽然美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在7月初承诺发放许可证，但他后来放弃了这一承诺，据报道，由于伊朗战争造成的短缺，他拒绝发送更多的防空导弹。

俄罗斯谴责乌克兰袭击油轮是“恐怖主义行为”，同时指责基辅袭击民用基础设施。

哈萨克斯坦也对无人机袭击表示抗议，但没有直接指责乌克兰。哈萨克斯坦称，对运送CPC原油的民用船只的袭击是对其经济利益的“不可接受的侵犯”，并警告称，这些袭击可能会破坏合法贸易、能源市场和全球供应链的稳定。

但基辅公开拒绝承担责任，并敦促哈萨克斯坦和其他受影响国家“不要做出仓促和毫无根据的指责”

excerpt: The US warned Ukraine against attacking tankers using a Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal co-owned by American firms, according to the FT Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
US President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance meet with Ukrainian leader Vladimir Zelensky in the Oval Office at the White House on February 28, 2025 in Washington, DC. © Andrew Harnik/Getty Images The US has called Ukraine to heel for targeting oil tankers in the Black Sea after Kiev began launching drone attacks on vessels sailing to a partly US-owned Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC) terminal in Russia, the Financial Times has reported.

Ukrainian drone raids targeting the CPC – which funnels Kazakh crude across southern Russia to a marine terminal near Novorossiysk, from where tankers carry it onward to Europe and Asia – have tested Washington's patience to the limit, prompting US Vice-President J.D. Vance to press Vladimir Zelensky to shut down the attacks during a July 31 phone call, unidentified Ukrainian officials told the FT.

The CPC route incorporates a combination of Russian, Kazakh, and Western interests, with Chevron and ExxonMobil among the heavyweight US shareholders.

While US President Donald Trump promised a license in early July, he later walked back on that pledge, while reportedly declining to send additional air defense missiles due to a shortfall caused by the Iran war.

Russia has denounced Ukraine's attacks on oil tankers as "terrorist acts," while accusing Kiev of targeting civilian infrastructure.

Kazakhstan also protested the drone raids, though without directly blaming Ukraine. It called the strikes on civilian vessels moving CPC crude as an "unacceptable infringement" on its economic interests and warned that they risked destabilizing lawful trade, energy markets, and global supply chains.

However, Kiev publicly refused to accept responsibility and urged Kazakhstan and other affected countries to "refrain from making hasty and unfounded accusations."

虽然美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在7月初承诺发放许可证，但他后来放弃了这一承诺，据报道，由于伊朗战争造成的短缺，他拒绝发送更多的防空导弹。

俄罗斯谴责乌克兰袭击油轮是“恐怖主义行为”，同时指责基辅袭击民用基础设施。

哈萨克斯坦也对无人机袭击表示抗议，但没有直接指责乌克兰。哈萨克斯坦称，对运送CPC原油的民用船只的袭击是对其经济利益的“不可接受的侵犯”，并警告称，这些袭击可能会破坏合法贸易、能源市场和全球供应链的稳定。

但基辅公开拒绝承担责任，并敦促哈萨克斯坦和其他受影响国家“不要做出仓促和毫无根据的指责”

title: 2026中东最新局势：日内瓦谈判+双航母压境，美伊博弈临界 ...
content:
2026年开年，中东进入外交谈判与军事对峙并行的高压状态。一边是2月17日美伊在瑞士日内瓦举行第二轮间接谈判、释放缓和信号，一边是美军双航母压境、五代机密集部署，伊朗同步在霍尔木兹海峡开展实兵演习，战与和的天平持续摇摆，直接牵动全球油价、黄金及各类市场走势。

当前全球石油市场基本面宽松，短期油价中枢维持在60—70美元/桶，但地缘政治成为定价核心。2026年油市核心规律明确：谈判缓和则油价回落，对峙升级则油价跳涨，中东局势直接决定全球能源市场稳定。

日内瓦谈判前后，美军完成大规模海空集结，以压促谈意图明显。林肯号航母驻守阿拉伯海，福特号紧急驰援形成双航母战斗群，搭载战斧导弹可覆盖伊朗全境；2月16日，18架F-35A隐身战机驰援中东，同步部署爱国者、萨德反导系统，中东驻军约4—6万人，侧重远程精确打击，不开展地面战。

谈判同期，伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡举行实兵演习，亮出反制底牌：革命卫队海军出动快速反应部队，演练电子战、海上封锁和饱和打击，无人机蜂群、高速快艇及岸基反舰导弹同步参演，数千枚弹道导弹瞄准美军基地与以色列，依托完备防御体系，坚守“不主动开战、绝不妥协”的战略，可通过封锁海峡反击对手。

当地时间2月17日，在阿曼的斡旋下，美伊举行第二轮间接谈判，双方就谈判指导原则达成共识，同意两周内继续接触。但核心分歧仍在：伊朗坚持和平核权利与导弹自主，美国则要求严控伊朗核计划并实现可核查。谈判后，油价短线跳水2%—3%，地缘风险溢价回落但未完全消除，边谈判、边增兵的格局未改变。

结合双方动态，局势结论明确：全面战争概率几乎为零，有限空袭或摩擦概率中等偏上，2026年3—7月为高风险窗口，伊朗核突破、袭击美军、封锁海峡、谈判破裂均可能触发局势升级，未来将呈现“边谈边压、以打促谈、摩擦常态化”的态势。

1. 谈判延续+有限摩擦（最可能）：布伦特油价78—85美元/桶，黄金5100—5300美元/盎司，能源、军工、黄金板块阶段性走强；

2. 谈判停滞+伊朗出口受阻：布伦特油价90—105美元/桶，黄金5300—5500美元/盎司，通胀抬头，全球股市承压；

3. 极端情况（海峡封锁）：布伦特油价120—150美元/桶（短期冲160美元），黄金突破5800—6000美元/盎司，全球市场震荡，避险资产成避风港。

2026年，中东局势是全球关注的核心：日内瓦谈判仅实现短期降温，美伊军事对峙长期存在，霍尔木兹海峡仍是全球能源最脆弱的命门，油市波动直接由谈判进展与军事动作决定，紧盯中东动态、布局能源与避险资产是核心主线。

content: 我在更新我的CachyOS系统。复制了AUR差异，（仍在学习Linux，所以..）问克劳德是否可以找到任何恶意与Arch AUR恶意软件攻击的上下文.有问题的包是librtmp 0克劳德说librtmp 0的维护者从“Maxime Gauduin”改为“Damglador”.我应该小心.它还说，有些东西是关于版本颠簸可疑.：剧透我问什么：::这些AUR软件包的评估基于最近从2026年6月开始的“Atomic Arch”恶意软件活动，我可以为您提供分析：|包|地位|风险水平|注意到||---------|--------|-----------|-------||lib32-gstreamer|安全|低|简单的版本升级（1.28.4 → 1.28.5），b2 sum哈希更新干净。没有新的依赖项。||lib32-gst-plugins-base-libs|安全|低|仅版本凹凸，与gstreamer相同的模式。||lib32-libpng12|安全|低|轻微的pkgrel bump（3 → 4）。完整的PKGBUILD显示-没有恶意的npm包或可疑的安装钩子。||librtmp0|需要️审查|介质|Maintainer由Maxime Gauduin改为Damglador，这正是Atomic Arch使用的攻击模式（新维护者采用包）。全PK

content: 作者：Chris吉尔伯特和Cira Pascual Marquina -2026年7月6日地震打断了日常生活，但不是历史。它们也没有暂停政治。如果有的话，它们将历史压缩成几个戏剧性的日子，揭示了通常隐藏在表面之下的社会关系，政治项目和地缘政治力量。委内瑞拉地震也不例外。正如我们在最近的一篇文章中所说，地震的影响沿着物质和社会的裂痕蔓延，这些裂痕已经被十年的严厉制裁和其他帝国主义侵略深深地刻下。随之而来的是不可避免的主权和意义的斗争。尽管这些斗争集中在委内瑞拉，但这些斗争属于更广泛的历史图景：越来越咄咄逼人地企图重新确立美国对拉丁美洲的统治。在华盛顿开始推进其议程之前，地面几乎没有停止震动。一个天真或充满希望的观察家可能会期望美国-在这一点上，领导反对委内瑞拉政府的运动有所缓和。毕竟，加拉加斯在1月3日之后的时期，在巨大的军事和经济压力下，向美国做出了一系列让步。相反，相反的事情发生了。在几个小时内，

title_zh: 对抗健忘症：委内瑞拉地震、历史时刻和大陆问题
content_en: By Chris Gilbert and Cira Pascual Marquina – Jul 06, 2026 Earthquakes interrupt everyday life, but not history. Nor do they suspend politics. If anything, they compress history into a few dramatic days, revealing social relations, political projects, and geopolitical forces that ordinarily remain beneath the surface. The Venezuelan earthquake is no exception. As we argued in a recent article, the quake’s impact spread along material and social fractures that were already carved deep by a decade of crippling sanctions and other imperialist aggressions. In its wake came inevitable struggles over sovereignty and meaning. Although centered in Venezuela, these struggles belong to a broader historical picture: the increasingly aggressive attempt to reassert U.S. domination over Latin America. The ground had hardly stopped shaking before Washington began advancing its agenda. A naive or hopeful observer might have expected the U.S.-led campaign against the Venezuelan government to ease at this point. title: 委内瑞拉推进电力恢复，而美国“检查”Guri大坝
content: 加拉加斯（OrinocoTribune.com）-委内瑞拉代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯领导视察了卡拉博博州的Planta Centro和Termo卡拉博博热电厂，监督6月24日地震后恢复国家电力系统（SEN）的努力。她的视察于8月4日星期二进行，此前一天，美国驻加拉加斯大使馆宣布，一个代表团--包括临时代办约翰·巴雷特和美国能源部的技术专家--曾评估过西蒙·玻利瓦尔水电站，通常被称为古里大坝。这次访问受到严厉批评，因为古里是委内瑞拉最重要和战略敏感的发电设施，美国帝国官员的存在直接威胁到国家的关键基础设施。对比鲜明的访问突出了围绕委内瑞拉电力系统的两个不同方面：玻利瓦尔政府努力恢复在地震中受损的基础设施，以及华盛顿在一个多年来受到美国殖民制裁和破坏稳定行动的战略部门的不断扩大的参与。

title_en: ‘Hands Off Asia means socialism today,’ says Vijay Prashad at Colombo conference
title_zh: Vijay Prashad在科隆博会议上说，“放手亚洲意味着今天的社会主义”
content_en: Asia is home to about 60% of the world’s population and is increasingly the motor of the world’s economy. The continent also has a long tradition of revolutionary national liberation struggles and left and progressive movements. Today the people and governments of Asia today find themselves in the crosshairs of a New Cold War, gasping for breath under the yoke of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and bearing the burden of tens of thousands of US troops stationed in close to 400 bases spread across the region. In this context, what does genuine sovereignty mean for the people of the continent, and how can progressive organizations join hands to construct this sovereignty? These questions were at the center of “Hands Off Asia: A People’s Call for Sovereignty and Solidarity,” a conference organized by the International Peoples’ Assembly and the Tricontinental: Institute for Social Research from July 16–18, 2026 in Colombo, Sri Lanka. title: 美国、土耳其官员怀疑导致特朗普换机的“阴谋”是以色列的鲁塞诡计
content: 据报道，美国和土耳其官员怀疑，上个月导致唐纳德·特朗普总统使用一辆餐饮卡车精心逃离安卡拉的所谓伊朗暗杀阴谋可能是以色列情报部门捏造的。本周早些时候，据报道，特朗普不得不秘密登上一架不起眼的飞机，离开7月8日的北约峰会，此前以色列向中情局传递了一份情报报告，警告说，伊朗曾计划向“空军一号”发射一枚导弹。但新的报道显示，土耳其和美国官员都没有发现令人信服的证据。所谓的威胁发生在一个高度动荡的时期，因为美国和伊朗之间旨在结束近五个月战争的“谅解备忘录”濒临崩溃，部分原因是以色列试图破坏它。正如中东之眼周二报道的那样，土耳其官员暗示，这份情报报告“可能是[以色列总理本杰明]内塔尼亚胡政府的鲁塞，目的是把自己描绘成保护特朗普，破坏与伊朗的谈判，破坏特朗普与（土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安）显然密切的关系。

content_en: US and Turkish officials are reportedly suspicious that the supposed Iranian assassination plot that led President Donald Trump to make an elaborate escape from Ankara using a catering truck last month may have been a fabrication by Israeli intelligence. Earlier this week, it was reported that Trump had to be secreted onto a nondescript plane to leave a NATO summit on July 8 after Israel passed an intelligence report to the CIA warning that Iran had planned to launch a missile at Air Force One. But new reporting indicates that neither Turkish nor American officials found the evidence all that compelling. title: 利比亚东部汽车炸弹炸死哈夫塔尔情报局长
content: 的黎波里（法新社）-利比亚国民军（LNA）的军事情报负责人，控制着利比亚东部和南部的部分地区，已在一次汽车爆炸中丧生，军队在周二的一份声明中说。法齐al-Mandarin周一被暗杀时，一个爆炸物粘在他的汽车爆炸，当他晚上离开当地的清真寺，声明说。报道称，这起杀戮发生在利比亚东部城市班加西。自2011年前领导人卡扎菲被赶下台期间陷入战争以来，利比亚一直处于分裂状态。两个政府目前正在争夺权力：联合国承认的的黎波里政府由总理阿卜杜勒哈米德·德贝巴领导，班加西的一个竞争对手由军事指挥官和LNA负责人哈利法·哈夫塔尔支持。哈利法的儿子哈立德·哈夫塔尔在一份声明中告诉法新社，调查已经开始，他补充说，“种种迹象表明，这是一种卑鄙的恐怖主义策略”。“恐怖主义是一个针对整个地区的项目，而不仅仅是利比亚，声明补充说，这次爆炸事件是哈夫塔尔试图在他们控制的地区描绘稳定局面的努力的一个挫折。

content_en: Tripoli (AFP) – The head of military intelligence for the Libyan National Army (LNA), which controls the east and parts of southern Libya, has been killed in a car bombing, the army said in a statement Tuesday. Fawzi al-Mansouri was assassinated on Monday when an explosive stuck to his car detonated as he was leaving a local mosque at night, the statement said. Reports said the killing occurred in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi. Libya has remained divided since being plunged into war during the ousting in 2011 of former leader Muammar Gaddafi. Two governments are currently vying for power: the UN-recognised administration in Tripoli led by Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah, and a rival in Benghazi backed by military commander and LNA chief Khalifa Haftar. Khaled Haftar, the son of Khalifa, told AFP in a statement that an investigation was opened, adding that "indicators point to a despicable terrorist tactic". "Terrorism is a project targeting the entire region, not just Libya," the statement added. title: 关于中国在海外投资过渡矿产开采相关的侵犯人权行为的增加|报告
content: 交叉发布自：https://mander.xyz/post/55889087根据今天发表的一项新研究，与中国公司在能源转型关键矿产领域的海外投资有关的人权和环境危害正在逐年增加。商业与人权中心记录了2023年至2025年期间的326起侵权指控，自2021年以来，与中国公司有关的过渡性矿产项目的指控总数达到434起。中国对过渡性矿产开采项目的投资在全球范围内的分布显然是数据反映了这一点，印度尼西亚的指控数量最多（96起），其次是刚果民主共和国（52起）、缅甸（36起）、塞尔维亚（32起）和津巴布韦（20起）。该报告强调，对电动汽车、电池和可再生能源技术所必需的矿产的投资迅速扩大，正在加剧工人、土著人民、当地社区和环境。这一点，再加上那些因公开反对公司而被噤声的人所处的环境越来越令人担忧，描绘了一幅与中国公司相关的过渡矿产供应链的令人担忧的画面。

title_zh: 关于中国在海外投资过渡矿产开采相关的侵犯人权行为的增加|报告
content_en: cross-posted from: https://mander.xyz/post/55889087 Human rights and environmental harms linked to Chinese companies’ overseas investments in minerals critical to the energy transition are increasing year on year, according to new research published today. The Business and Human Rights Centre documented 326 allegations of abuse between 2023 and 2025, bringing the total recorded since 2021 to 434 allegations across transition mineral projects linked to Chinese companies. The global spread of Chinese investment in transition mineral mining projects was clearly reflected in the data, with Indonesia recording the highest number of allegations (96), followed by the Democratic Republic of Congo (52), Myanmar (36), Serbia (32) and Zimbabwe (20). The report highlights how the rapid expansion of investment in minerals essential for electric vehicles, batteries and renewable energy technologies are intensifying risks for workers, Indigenous Peoples, local communities and the environment. It identifies the vast majority of problems with the country’s rapidly expanding nickel industry. That increase doesn’t necessarily mean the number of abuses themselves have tripled, as changes in reporting, monitoring, and the database can affect the figures. Still, the rising trend comes as investment in the minerals used in electric vehicles, batteries, and renewable energy technologies expands rapidly, raising risks for workers, Indigenous peoples, local communities, and the environment. But its significance goes far beyond the construction of power stations. By permitting the possibility that Saudi Arabia might eventually enrich uranium on its own soil, while apparently exempting the kingdom from the most intrusive international inspections, Washington has further weakened the already fragile international regime against nuclear proliferation. content: 简介：哲学危机在英国，在过去的几年里，哲学一直受到国家认可的攻击。肯特大学哲学系的关闭，斯塔福德郡大学和赫特福德郡大学哲学系的解散，以及金斯顿大学现代欧洲哲学研究中心的关闭，对那些与现代欧洲哲学相关的机构造成了不成比例的影响。被称为“大陆哲学”。这构成了哲学的危机。对于国家的“商人”来说，（Geshäftleute），那些“政府的工具/工具”，正如康德在他1798年的《院系的冲突》中所称，哲学和人文学科的危机更广泛地被描述为一个“工具性"下降的问题。[[i]]（edn 1）如果一个人是一个工具，一个人的思维是工具性的，国家的商人也不例外。在他们的教学和研究中，越来越多的人需要通过可衡量的影响、政策相关性、技术适用性或经济生产力来证明他们的话语的持续存在。

content_en: Introduction: A Philosophical Crisis In the UK, over the last several years, philosophy has come under sustained state-sanctioned attack. The closure of the University of Kent’s Department of Philosophy, the dismantling of philosophy provision at Staffordshire University and the University of Hertfordshire, and the closure of Kingston University’s Centre for Research in Modern European Philosophy have disproportionately affected institutions associated with what is commonly termed “continental philosophy.” This constitutes nothing short of a crisis for philosophy. For the state’s “businessmen” ( Geshäftleute ), those “tools/instruments of the government,” as Kant calls them in his 1798 The Conflict of the Faculties , the crisis in philosophy and the humanities more broadly is presented as a problem of declining “instrumentality.”[[i]]( edn1) If one is an instrument, one thinks instrumentally, and the businessmen of the state are no different. Disciplines, in both their teaching and their research, are increasingly required to justify the continued existence of their discourse through measurable impact, policy relevance, technological applicability, or economic productivity. One small example of Spafford-at-his-best is his response to arguments like those made by libertarian philosopher Michael Huemer (and discussed here). Huemer thinks a government taxing your income to finance a welfare state is like a mugger who plans to spend the money in your wallet on charity. In both cases, maybe the theft can be justified if the purpose is morally urgent enough, but both are theft, and are therefore morally guilty until proven innocent. The fact that the particular gang of muggers that finances the welfare state is a particularly large and powerful one that calls itself a “government” and has considerable public support is neither here nor there. People are just people, and if it’s wrong for random people to use force in particular way, it’s equally wrong for a “government” to do so. title: 为阿尔巴尼亚库什纳度假村出售土地的商人涉嫌伪造契约
content: 谁能想到这最终会被所谓的腐败，犯罪，洗钱，毒资和伪造所困扰。摘要-阿尔巴尼亚检察官指控Artur Shehu伪造了出售给库什纳支持的度假村的土地契约-检察官已经冻结了公证账户中的销售资金，阻止Shehu接收它们-检察官指控Shehu洗钱和毒品走私地拉那，7月11日（路透社）-阿尔巴尼亚打击有组织犯罪机构在路透社审查的案件档案中表示，一名因涉嫌洗钱而被阿尔巴尼亚通缉的迈阿密商人涉嫌伪造土地契约，贾里德·库什纳希望在那里建造一个价值数十亿美元的度假胜地。这名商人名叫阿图尔·谢胡，他的律师库吉蒂姆·卡克拉尼说，他否认对他的所有指控。他证实，阿尔巴尼亚检察官已发出逮捕令，要求逮捕谢胡，罪名是为贩毒团伙洗钱。案卷指控谢胡及其同伙将南美可卡因贩运到欧洲港口，并利用这些资金建立一个非法的真实的房地产帝国，包括伪造土地所有权文件。“

The businessman, Artur Shehu, denies all accusations against him, said his lawyer, Kujtim Cakrani, who confirmed that Albanian prosecutors had issued a warrant seeking Shehu's arrest for laundering money for drug gangs. The case files accuse Shehu and associates of trafficking South American cocaine into European ports, and laundering the funds by using them to establish a ‌real estate empire, including with falsified land-ownership documents. title: 从“中国特色社会主义”到“欧洲特色人权”--伊朗
content: 2026年7月29日-欧洲领导人明确提出要通过一个全新的概念来塑造21世纪的地缘政治：具有欧洲特色的人权。这是否是他们对“中国特色社会主义”的回应？任何对打着人权旗号的欧盟政策的评估，自然会提出一个初步的问题：布鲁塞尔所定义的这些人权是欧盟的战略目标，本身就是目的，还是仅仅是一种地缘政治工具--一种旨在实现其他目标的策略？换句话说，在欧盟成员国不断援引人权的背后，最终目标是赋予那些受到不公正待遇的人民权利吗？如果我们所说的“人权”是指1948年《世界人权宣言》所载的权利，那么，只要对全球作一个简要的回顾，就会清楚地发现，这些布鲁塞尔大肆吹嘘的权利，只存在于欧洲精英的笔墨和唾液之中。伊朗提供了一个特别能说明21世纪欧洲“人道主义”的例子。

Could this be their response to “socialism with Chinese characteristics”? Any assessment of EU policies carried out under the banner of human rights naturally raises a preliminary question: Are these human rights, as defined by Brussels, a strategic objective of the EU, an end in themselves, or simply a geopolitical tool—a tactic aimed at achieving other goals? In other words, behind the EU members’ constant invocation of human rights, is the ultimate goal to grant rights to populations that have been unjustly wronged? If by “human rights” we mean the rights enshrined in the 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights, a brief global overview will reveal unequivocally that these rights , which Brussels boasts so much about, exist nowhere else but in the ink and saliva of the European elites. content_en: For more than six decades, the United States has attempted to make the Cuban people pay for their decision to pursue an independent, socialist path. The latest phase of this economic war has targeted the island’s most vulnerable artery: its energy supply. Six months after Washington intensified pressure on countries and companies supplying oil to Cuba, the policy has not produced democracy or improved the lives of ordinary Cubans. It has produced darker homes, immobilized buses, interrupted hospitals, and greater difficulty in moving food from farms to cities. The immediate task is to prevent a humanitarian disaster. The larger task is to replace coercion with sovereign cooperation and to help Cuba build an energy system that cannot again be strangled by a foreign power. title: 菲律宾学校射手在直播袭击中杀死了同学和自己
content:
菲律宾南部城市三宝颜发生两个月来第二起致命校园枪击

案。一名学生在菲律宾南部的一间教室里直播自己开枪打死另一名学生，然后自杀，这是菲律宾不到两个月内发生的第二起校园袭击事件。

枪击案发生在南部城市三宝颜的一所附属于三宝颜雅典耀大学的学校，这是棉兰老岛西部的一所天主教私立学校。三宝颜市市长凯默·阿丹·奥拉索，告诉DZMM广播电台，枪手“设法进入携带高功率火器和.45口径手枪”。

继续阅读.

title: 阿联酋在所谓的“海上航行”袭击后停止了与伊朗的所有贸易
content:
文件图片。© Getty Images / Anadolu / Mamoun Wazwaz阿联酋指责伊朗周二向其方向发射了两枚弹道导弹，因为美伊和平谈判的两个月窗口到期而没有取得突破。事件发生后，阿布扎比宣布停止与德黑兰的所有贸易和金融交易。

阿联酋国防部和国家紧急危机和灾害管理局（NCEMA）报告了这起事件。这些机构没有明确说明来袭导弹是否被击落。军方表示，其中一枚落入该国领海沃茨，而第二枚落在外面。

当天晚些时候，国防部说，这些炮弹似乎袭击了“海上航行”。国防部没有具体说明据称袭击目标的船只是在国内还是国际沃茨内行驶。

在阿联酋军方提供了对所谓袭击的最新评估后不久，外交部宣布停止与伊朗的所有贸易和交易。

“鉴于破坏地区和国际和平与安全的地区升级，与伊朗的所有活动，贸易交流和金融交易都已暂停，直至另行通知，”该部在一份声明中说。

伊朗尚未对这些指控发表公开评论。在美国和以色列对伊朗开战的高潮时期，德黑兰多次将矛头对准这个海湾国家，指责它允许美国军队利用其领土发动袭击。

周二早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普证实，与伊朗“没有进行或安排任何会谈或对话”。他声称：“海军封锁仍然完全有效。霍尔木兹海峡是开放和运作的。所有的水雷都已被拆除或引爆。”

伊朗最高国家安全理事会秘书雷扎伊星期二重申了这一立场，认为华盛顿的失败

excerpt: The UAE has accused Iran of firing two ballistic missiles at it on Tuesday, as the two-month window for US-Iran peace talks expired Read Full Article at RT.com
fullText:
FILE PHOTO. © Getty Images / Anadolu / Mamoun Wazwaz The UAE has accused Iran of firing two ballistic missiles in its direction on Tuesday, as the two-month window for US-Iran peace talks expired without a breakthrough. Following the incident, Abu Dhabi announced a halt to all trade and financial transactions with Tehran.

The alleged incident was reported by the UAE's Defense Ministry and the National Emergency Crisis and Disasters Management Authority (NCEMA). The agencies did not explicitly say whether the incoming missiles were shot down. The military stated that one of them fell inside the country's territorial waters, while the second landed outside.

Later in the day, the Defense Ministry said the projectiles appeared to have attacked "maritime navigation." The ministry did not specify whether the allegedly targeted vessels were traveling within the country's domestic or international waters.

Shortly after the UAE's military provided the update on its assessment of the alleged attack, the Foreign Ministry announced a halt to all trade and transactions with Iran over the incident.

"In light of the regional escalation that undermined regional and international peace and security, all activities, trade exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran have been suspended until further notice," the ministry said in a statement.

Iran has not publicly commented on the allegations. At the height of the US-Israeli war on Iran, Tehran repeatedly targeted the Gulf nation, accusing it of allowing US forces to use its territory to launch attacks.

Earlier on Tuesday, US President Donald Trump confirmed that "no talks or conversations [were] going on, or scheduled" with Iran. "The Naval Blockade remains in full force and effect. The Hormuz Strait is open and operating. All water mines have been removed or detonated," he claimed.

Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council (SNSC), reiterated the position on Tuesday, arguing that Washington's failure to reopen the strait signaled "the post-American order in the Persian Gulf."

"The gap between America's inability to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and its claim to own it is greater than the 7,000-mile distance between Washington and the Strait itself," Rezaei wrote on X.

伊朗尚未对这些指控发表公开评论。在美国和以色列对伊朗开战的高潮时期，德黑兰多次将矛头对准这个海湾国家，指责它允许美国军队利用其领土发动袭击。

周二早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普证实，与伊朗“没有进行或安排任何会谈或对话”。他声称：“海军封锁仍然完全有效。霍尔木兹海峡是开放和运作的。所有的水雷都已被拆除或引爆。”

伊朗最高国家安全理事会秘书雷扎伊星期二重申了这一立场，认为华盛顿的失败

title: 传播淫秽色情等信息，105款APP被国家网信办清理下架
content: 新京报快讯 据网信中国官微消息，针对网民反映强烈的部分移动应用程序传播淫秽色情、暴恐血腥等违法违规信息，提供诈骗赌博、招嫖卖淫等违法违规服务的网络乱象，国家网信办依据《网络安全法》《网络信息内容生态治理规定》《移动互联网应用程序信息服务管理规定》等法律法规和国家有关规定，自11月5日起组织开展移动应用程序信息内容乱象专项整治，首批清理下架猫途鹰、苏格、面具公园、剧能玩、视界、tata、西蒂、瘾欢、单身交友聊吧、黑夜漂流瓶、菲姬、夜撸云、花姿直播、麻豆传媒、豆浆TV播放器、红杏视频、青青草视频、享色、含羞草、柠檬、噗噗漫画、51漫画、韩漫人、火山阅读等105款违法违规移动应用程序。

title: 血色子午线 (豆瓣)
content:
他们骑马出城，走上北方的道路，那是蛮荒之地的方向，但当他们还未完全消失在城市的视线之外，他们便悲剧性地调转坐骑的头，前往西边，痴迷地、沉醉地骑向那西天的晚红，骑向傍晚的土地和远方日落中的喧嚣……

霍尔顿法官是一个与莎士比亚作品中的伊阿古有相似文学价值的凶徒和恶魔，在麦卡锡笔下暴力描绘已变成了令人惊叹的艺术技能，一种可与梅尔维尔和福克纳一较高低的艺术技能。在我看来，《血色子午线》应该是美国真正的末世预言小说。——哈罗德?布卢姆

麦卡锡先生明示我们去见证邪恶不是为了去理解邪恶，而是为了去证实其不可解释的现实存在，他精巧的语言将现实与超现实链接在一起，震动得我们无法再安然于现状。——凯林?詹姆斯（《纽约时报》书评人）

千年之后还会有新的队伍出发去寻找可以换钱的印第安人头皮队伍中还会有互相看不顺眼的黑鬼杰克逊白人杰克逊还会有随便开枪的大卫布朗还会有本来是牧师而现在一举一动都在亵渎上帝的托宾还会有老练的托德文还会有充当傀儡的特拉华人还会有一个沉默寡言的少年。而麦卡锡立于高山之巅冷静而安详地详细记录着每一步路线每一次杀戮每一滩鲜血飞溅每一下枪声每一声惨叫他喃喃自语道法官是不死的这些人都是不死的直到世界的尽头他们都是不... 千年之后还会有新的队伍出发去寻找可以换钱的印第安人头皮队伍中还会有互相看不顺眼的黑鬼杰克逊白人杰克逊还会有随便开枪的大卫布朗还会有本来是牧师而现在一举一动都在亵渎上帝的托宾还会有老练的托德文还会有充当傀儡的特拉华人还会有一个沉默寡言的少年。而麦卡锡立于高山之巅冷静而安详地详细记录着每一步路线每一次杀戮每一滩鲜血飞溅每一下枪声每一声惨叫他喃喃自语道法官是不死的这些人都是不死的直到世界的尽头他们都是不死的所有人啊你们要看清楚。而远处的队伍继续前进众人血红的眼睛捕捉着地平线上一切可能是印第安人动静的迹象而他们的形象被炙热的沙漠空气和马鼻喷出的热气所扭曲而队伍中法官仿佛听到了麦卡锡的话他转过巨婴般的秃头来没有一根毛发的脸上露出笑容而眼神中露出一丝嘲弄而满足的神情他说只有他确实是不死的。 ( 展开 )

一个人，若是相信世界上的秘密永远不可获知，那他便活在神秘和恐惧之中。迷信会使他萎顿沮丧。雨水会销蚀他生活中的功绩。但是一个人若能面对世界之挂毯，从中抽出秩序之线，仅仅因为这一个决定，他便能掌管世界，而且只有通过这样的方式，他才能实现对自身命运的掌控。

有一种好评，叫“我读不懂，但我知道这是一本好书”。

content: 10月1日至4日，全省大部分市县晴到多云，局部地区可能有雷阵雨，白天气温较高。 未来两天，台风影响将持续。 陆地方面，28日全市阴天有暴雨到大暴雨、局部特大暴雨；29日转为多云间阴天，有中雨到大雨、局部暴雨。 28日至29日，内陆地区阵风9～10级，沿海地区阵风11～12级。 根据最新气象数据，“博罗依”将于27日凌晨正式进入南海东部海域，随后向西北方向移动，强度持续增强。 气象部门预测，该台风最强可能达到台风级，需重点监测其是否会登陆或掠过海南岛，沿海居民及游客需提高警惕。 今天起，超强台风“桦加沙”将开始影响我国，今起四天（9月22日至25日），华南、华东多地将陆续迎来强风雨天气。 同时，华西至黄淮地区降雨持续，四川、陕西、河南、山东将先后出现暴雨，公众需提前做好防御准备。

title: 被女友强奸了咋办
content: 根据《中华人民共和国刑法》第二百三十六条，以暴力、胁迫或者其他手段强奸妇女的，处三年以上十年以下有期徒刑。 法规1. 这一条款明确规定了强奸罪的构成要件和刑罚幅度。 在此情况下，无论行为人与受害者之间的关系如何，只要符合强奸罪的构成要件，都应依法追究刑事责任。 综上所述，被女友强奸是一个严重的法律问题，需要立即报警、搜集证据并在法律人士的协助下进行处理。 法律将保护受害者的权益，并依法对犯罪者进行惩处。 以暴力、胁迫或者其他手段强奸妇女的，处三年以上十年以下有期徒刑。 奸淫不满十四周岁的幼女的，以强奸论，从重处罚。

content: 一架俄罗斯苏-35 S多用途战斗机罕见地进入乌克兰领空，飞越苏米州的乌赫罗伊迪镇，在安全返回库尔斯克州之前向苏米市发射了一枚Kh-59/69巡航导弹。通常情况下，苏-35 S、苏-30 SM/SM 2、而苏--34架飞机从前线后方大约50公里处发射滑翔炸弹和其他制导弹药，以最大限度地减少乌克兰防空系统拦截的风险。俄罗斯试图测试乌克兰的防空反应，但显然没有拦截，俄罗斯可能越来越相信，乌克兰目前缺乏足够的PAC-2/3拦截导弹，对其飞机构成重大威胁。

title_zh: 俄罗斯一架苏-35多用途战斗机罕见地进入乌克兰领空，飞越苏米州的乌赫罗伊迪镇，
content_en: In a rare occurrence, a Russian Su-35S multirole fighter crossed into Ukrainian airspace, flew over the town of Uhroidy in Sumy Oblast, and launched a Kh-59/69 cruise missile at Sumy City before safely returning to Kursk Oblast. Normally, Su-35S, Su-30SM/SM2, and Su-34 aircraft launch glide bombs and other guided munitions from roughly 50 km behind the frontline to minimize the risk of interception by Ukrainian air defenses. It may have been an attempt to test Ukraine’s air defense response, but apparently no interception followed. Russia may be increasingly confident that Ukraine currently lacks sufficient PAC-2/3 interceptor missiles to pose a significant threat to its aircraft.

title: 美国官员说，特朗普倾向于扩大美国在伊朗的军事行动，可能会加强空袭，向哈格岛派遣地面部队，B
content: 华盛顿--美国官员称，在高级助手进行了几天的简报后，特朗普总统倾向于扩大美国在伊朗的军事行动。选项包括加强空袭，派遣地面部队夺取霍尔木兹海峡附近的伊朗岛屿，并轰炸一个可能用于秘密核工作的设防地点。特朗普周二晚间主持了一次情况室会议，讨论夺取哈格岛的可能性，使用美国军队占领霍尔木兹海峡沿着的其他领土，以及可能轰炸美国尚未瞄准的核设施--匹克克斯山的一个隧道设施。扩大对伊朗更多目标的空袭，包括能源设施，这也是一种可能性。这场讨论是特朗普最近几天与包括副总统在内的高级官员举行的多次正式和非正式对话之一这些官员说，美国总统万斯、国防部长赫格塞斯、国务卿鲁比奥和参谋长联席会议主席凯恩将军参加了空袭。美国军方说，周三对伊朗发动了两波空袭，目标是伊朗威胁通过海峡的船只的能力。“我们会找到他们的目标，”他说，“我们会找到他们的目标。”

content_en: WASHINGTON—President Trump is leaning toward expanding U.S. military operations in Iran after days of briefings from top aides, U.S. officials said. Options include stepping up airstrikes, sending ground forces to seize Iranian islands near the Strait of Hormuz and bombing a fortified site that could be used for covert nuclear work. Trump hosted a Situation Room meeting Tuesday evening to discuss the potential seizure of Kharg Island and other territory along the Strait of Hormuz using U.S. troops, as well as the potential bombing of a tunnel complex at Pickaxe Mountain, a nuclear-linked site the U.S. has yet to target. Expanding airstrikes against more targets in Iran, including energy sites, also remains a possibility. The discussion was one of multiple formal and informal conversations Trump has held in recent days with senior officials including Vice President JD Vance, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Gen. Dan Caine, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the officials said. title: 乌克兰是一个“脆弱”的民主国家：“内部政治动荡将削弱政治体系”
content: 奥利弗·法里很高兴地欢迎乌克兰哲学家、记者、作家兼乌克兰笔会主席弗拉基米尔·叶尔莫连科博士。据叶尔莫连科博士说，乌克兰的民主正面临严重威胁。在战争期间暂停选举会带来真实的危险，因为政治权力越来越集中在泽连斯基总统周围。然而，在城市仍然受到攻击的情况下举行选举，可能会引发乌克兰最不可能发生的政治动荡乌克兰面临的挑战不仅仅是应该选择民主还是战时统一，而是如何在不允许内部政治冲突削弱其对俄罗斯的抵抗的情况下保持民主问责制。

title_en: Ukraine a 'genuine', 'fragile' democracy: 'Internal political turmoil will weaken political system'
title_zh: 乌克兰是一个“脆弱”的民主国家：“内部政治动荡将削弱政治体系”
content_en: Oliver Farry is pleased to welcome Dr. Volodymyr Yermolenko, Ukrainian philosopher, journalist, author and President of PEN Ukraine. According to Dr Yermolenko, Ukraine is confronting serious threats to its democracy. Suspending elections during wartime carries real dangers as political power is increasingly centralized around President Zelensky. Yet holding elections while cities remain under attack could unleash precisely the political turmoil Ukraine can least afford. The challenge is not simply whether Ukraine should choose democracy or wartime unity, but how it can preserve democratic accountability without allowing internal political conflict to weaken its resistance to Russia.
